items.label: orthogonalSum_stepLength
items.statement: Orthogonal-sum transport leaves the step-length sequence unchanged.
items.title: orthogonalSum_stepLength

items.label: pointMemObjectiveSublevelOfWeakWolfe
items.statement:
Helper for TASK-15: every point of a positive-step inverse-form DFP
weak-Wolfe trajectory stays in its initial objective sublevel set.
items.title: pointMemObjectiveSublevelOfWeakWolfe

items.label: pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_gradients
items.statement:
The canonical gradient sequence of an isometric pullback is obtained by applying
the inverse isometry to the original canonical gradients.
items.title: pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_gradients

items.label: pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_inverseHessian
items.statement:
Pullback through a linear isometry represents the conjugated inverse-Hessian
operator in the target's canonical Euclidean basis.
items.title: pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_inverseHessian

items.label: pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_objective
items.statement:
Pullback through a linear isometry precomposes the iteration objective by that
isometry.
items.title: pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_objective

items.label: pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_point
items.statement: Pullback through a linear isometry applies the inverse isometry to every point.
items.title: pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_point

items.label: pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_stepLength
items.statement: Pullback through a linear isometry leaves the step-length sequence unchanged.
items.title: pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_stepLength

items.label: recurrence_spec
items.statement: The point and inverse-Hessian successor equations at one index of a DFP trajectory.
items.title: recurrence_spec

items.label: gradients_eq
items.statement:
A certified orbit's prescribed gradient sequence is the canonical gradient
of its objective along its point sequence.
items.title: gradients_eq

items.label: iff
items.statement:
An inverse-form DFP orbit is equivalent to its positivity, certified-gradient,
point-recurrence, and matrix-recurrence conditions.
items.title: iff

items.label: ofHasGradientAt
items.statement:
Positive step lengths, certified gradients, and the two DFP recurrence equations
construct an inverse-form DFP orbit.
items.title: ofHasGradientAt

items.label: orthogonalSum
items.statement:
The quadratic objective and identity-block matrices transport a certified DFP orbit
through the left orthogonal-sum embedding.
items.title: orthogonalSum

items.label: secantDenominator_ne_of_secantCurvature_pos
items.statement:
Positive secant curvature along a certified orbit makes every DFP secant
denominator nonzero.
items.title: secantDenominator_ne_of_secantCurvature_pos

items.label: toInverseIteration_inverseHessian
items.statement:
The inverse-Hessian sequence of the inverse iteration assembled from a certified
orbit is unchanged.
items.title: toInverseIteration_inverseHessian

items.label: toInverseIteration_inverseHessian_eq
items.statement:
The inverse-Hessian sequence of the inverse iteration assembled from a certified
orbit is unchanged.
items.title: toInverseIteration_inverseHessian_eq

items.label: toInverseIteration_objective
items.statement: The objective of the inverse iteration assembled from a certified orbit is unchanged.
items.title: toInverseIteration_objective

items.label: toInverseIteration_point
items.statement:
The point sequence of the inverse iteration assembled from a certified orbit is
unchanged.
items.title: toInverseIteration_point

items.label: toInverseIteration_point_eq
items.statement:
The point sequence of the inverse iteration assembled from a certified orbit is
unchanged.
items.title: toInverseIteration_point_eq

items.label: toInverseIteration_stepLength
items.statement:
The step-length sequence of the inverse iteration assembled from a certified orbit
is unchanged.
items.title: toInverseIteration_stepLength

items.label: toOperator
items.statement: A matrix-valued Euclidean DFP orbit induces the coordinate-free operator orbit.
items.title: toOperator

items.label: pullback
items.statement: Coordinate-free DFP orbits are invariant under an invertible linear change of variables.
items.title: pullback

items.label: pullback_of_initialFactor
items.statement:
Pulling back an orbit with a factored initial inverse Hessian produces an orbit initialized
at the identity.
items.title: pullback_of_initialFactor

items.label: toMatrix
items.statement:
A coordinate-free DFP orbit on Euclidean space induces a matrix-valued orbit in the
canonical orthonormal basis.
items.title: toMatrix

items.label: direction_apply
items.statement: Evaluation of the search direction determined by an inverse-Hessian operator.
items.title: direction_apply

items.label: direction_change
items.statement: Search directions commute with an invertible linear coordinate change.
items.title: direction_change

items.label: directions_apply
items.statement: Evaluation of the operator-valued search direction at an iteration index.
items.title: directions_apply

items.label: gradientChange_apply
items.statement: Evaluation of the secant vector between two gradient values.
items.title: gradientChange_apply

items.label: gradientChange_map
items.statement: A linear map commutes with the successive-gradient-difference operation.
items.title: gradientChange_map

items.label: gradientChanges_apply
items.statement: Evaluation of the successive gradient difference at an iteration index.
items.title: gradientChanges_apply

items.label: inverseUpdate_apply
items.statement: Evaluation of the inverse-form DFP operator update.
items.title: inverseUpdate_apply

items.label: inverseUpdate_change
items.statement: The inverse-form DFP update is covariant under an invertible linear coordinate change.
items.title: inverseUpdate_change

items.label: normalize_inverseHessian
items.statement:
A factorization `H = L ∘ L†` becomes the identity inverse Hessian after changing
coordinates by `L`.
items.title: normalize_inverseHessian

items.label: secantPairing_change
items.statement: A linear coordinate change preserves the secant pairing.
items.title: secantPairing_change

items.label: step_apply
items.statement: Evaluation of a scaled inverse-Hessian search step.
items.title: step_apply

items.label: step_change
items.statement: A scaled search step commutes with pulling back an invertible linear coordinate change.
items.title: step_change

items.label: steps_apply
items.statement: Evaluation of the operator-valued scaled displacement at an iteration index.
items.title: steps_apply

items.label: isOrbit
items.statement: A DFP orbit lifts through the orthogonal-sum embedding.
items.title: isOrbit

items.label: weakWolfe_iff
items.statement: The weak Wolfe conditions are invariant under the orthogonal-sum embedding.
items.title: weakWolfe_iff

items.label: directions_inl
items.statement:
Search directions for identity-block extensions are the embedded original search
directions.
items.title: directions_inl

items.label: dotProduct_inl
items.statement: The dot product of two left-embedded Euclidean vectors is their original dot product.
items.title: dotProduct_inl

items.label: gradientChanges_inl
items.statement:
Successive gradient differences commute with the canonical left orthogonal-sum
embedding.
items.title: gradientChanges_inl

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_extendMatrix_inl
items.statement:
An inverse-form DFP update by left-embedded secant vectors preserves the identity block.
No nonvanishing assumption on either update denominator is needed.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_extendMatrix_inl

items.label: steps_inl
items.statement: Scaled DFP steps commute with the canonical left orthogonal-sum embedding.
items.title: steps_inl

items.label: vecMul_extendMatrix_inl
items.statement: Left vector multiplication by an identity-block extension stays in the left summand.
items.title: vecMul_extendMatrix_inl

items.label: directions_embed
items.statement: Search directions for identity-block matrices are embedded original search directions.
items.title: directions_embed

items.label: embed_apply_inl
items.statement: The left coordinates of an embedded vector agree with the original vector.
items.title: embed_apply_inl

items.label: embed_apply_inr
items.statement: The right coordinates of an embedded vector vanish.
items.title: embed_apply_inr

items.label: embed_eq_inl
items.statement:
Helper for eq:counterexample-nonlipschitz: the DFP embedding is the
canonical left orthogonal-sum inclusion.
items.title: embed_eq_inl

items.label: gradientChanges_embed
items.statement: Successive gradient differences commute with the left orthogonal-sum embedding.
items.title: gradientChanges_embed

items.label: gradient_objective_embed
items.statement:
The gradient of the orthogonal-sum objective at an embedded point is the embedded
gradient of the original objective.
items.title: gradient_objective_embed

items.label: hasGradientAt_objective_embed
items.statement: A certified gradient embeds as a certified gradient of the orthogonal-sum objective.
items.title: hasGradientAt_objective_embed

items.label: hasHessianBounds_objective
items.statement:
Adjoining the quadratic `‖w‖² / 2` preserves Hessian bounds whenever the
new identity block lies between the same lower and upper bounds.
items.title: hasHessianBounds_objective

items.label: inner_embed
items.statement: The left orthogonal-sum embedding preserves the real inner product.
items.title: inner_embed

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_matrix
items.statement: An inverse-form DFP update by embedded secant vectors preserves the identity block.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_matrix

items.label: matrix_mulVec_embed
items.statement:
The identity-block extension acts on an embedded vector by the embedded original
matrix action.
items.title: matrix_mulVec_embed

items.label: matrix_posDef_iff
items.statement: Identity-block extension preserves and reflects positive definiteness.
items.title: matrix_posDef_iff

items.label: norm_embed
items.statement: The left orthogonal-sum embedding preserves norms.
items.title: norm_embed

items.label: objective_embed
items.statement: The orthogonal-sum objective restricts to the original objective on the left summand.
items.title: objective_embed

items.label: objective_eq
items.statement:
The DFP-facing orthogonal-sum objective is the generic gradient-level
orthogonal-sum objective.
items.title: objective_eq

items.label: secantPairing_embed
items.statement:
The secant pairing is unchanged by the left orthogonal-sum embedding and
identity-block extension.
items.title: secantPairing_embed

items.label: steps_embed
items.statement: Scaled DFP steps commute with the left orthogonal-sum embedding.
items.title: steps_embed

items.label: abstractSecantResidualNorm
items.statement:
Helper for eq:counterexample-nonlipschitz: an abstract DFP phase whose secant
matrix is `1 + εS` has gradient-change residual exactly `|ε|` times its step norm.
items.title: abstractSecantResidualNorm

items.label: armijoDescentOfHessianLowerBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: Armijo decrease on a strongly
convex objective forces the accepted displacement to have nonpositive
initial directional derivative.
items.title: armijoDescentOfHessianLowerBound

items.label: bumpCorrectionHessianHolder
items.statement:
Helper for eq:holder-hessian-bound: the full endpoint-bump correction has a global
one-half Hölder Hessian modulus after zero-extension across the limit circle.
items.title: bumpCorrectionHessianHolder

items.label: commonScaledSecantRatio
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: a common nonzero normalization
and orientation scale cancels from the exact DFP determinant ratio.
items.title: commonScaledSecantRatio

items.label: commonSignInner
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: a common sign preserves real
inner products, so orientation leaves normalized secant curvature unchanged.
items.title: commonSignInner

items.label: compactInitialSublevel
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: in a proper Hilbert space, a
positive global Hessian lower bound makes each initial sublevel compact.
items.title: compactInitialSublevel

items.label: convexInitialSublevel
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: a global positive Hessian lower
bound makes the initial sublevel convex, so all accepted step segments stay inside it.
items.title: convexInitialSublevel

items.label: correctedLogIncrementBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the four error bounds in the
corrected logarithmic identity yield one quadratic increment bound.
items.title: correctedLogIncrementBound

items.label: correctedLogIncrementIdentity
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the corrected log increment
splits exactly into determinant error, coefficient approximation error,
tangent cancellation, and the coefficient-variation correction.
items.title: correctedLogIncrementIdentity

items.label: counterexampleHessianNotLocallyLipschitz
items.statement:
Helper for eq:counterexample-nonlipschitz: a planar uniformly
convex weak-Wolfe counterexample cannot have a locally Lipschitz Hessian
on its initial objective sublevel.
items.title: counterexampleHessianNotLocallyLipschitz

items.label: curvature_mul_det_pos
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: positive definiteness makes the free
coefficient in the secant representation strictly positive.
items.title: curvature_mul_det_pos

items.label: distanceSquareBoundOfStationaryPoint
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: strong convexity turns the objective
gap above a stationary point into a bound on the squared point distance.
items.title: distanceSquareBoundOfStationaryPoint

items.label: endpointBumpHessianHolder
items.statement:
Helper for eq:holder-hessian-bound: the endpoint-bump family has a uniform local
square-root Hessian modulus after combining its scale and inverse-scale estimates.
items.title: endpointBumpHessianHolder

items.label: endpointBumpHessianLipschitz
items.statement:
Helper for eq:holder-hessian-bound: the Hessian of each endpoint bump is
Lipschitz with the inverse scale predicted by the shrinking construction.
items.title: endpointBumpHessianLipschitz

items.label: energyDirectionBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: a quadratic bound on the predicted
decrease of a positive multiple of `-v` gives the corresponding energy-to-direction bound.
items.title: energyDirectionBound

items.label: existsGlobalMinimizerOfHessian
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the strongly convex objective
attains a global minimum, obtained by minimizing on an initial sublevel.
items.title: existsGlobalMinimizerOfHessian

items.label: existsRealizedObjectiveHessianHolder
items.statement:
Helper for eq:holder-hessian-bound: the canonical invariant slow curve supplied
by the two-phase construction admits the concrete global one-half Hölder Hessian
bound for its realized objective.
items.title: existsRealizedObjectiveHessianHolder

items.label: existsUniqueGlobalMinimizerOfHessian
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the minimizer of an objective with
a positive global Hessian lower bound is unique.
items.title: existsUniqueGlobalMinimizerOfHessian

items.label: existsUniqueLimitOfC3
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: a strongly convex C3 objective
satisfies the Hessian regularity needed by the planar convergence theorem.
items.title: existsUniqueLimitOfC3

items.label: existsUniqueLimitOfLocallyLipschitzHessian
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence (infinite-orbit branch): every positive-step
classical planar DFP orbit on a globally strongly convex C2 objective with
locally Lipschitz Hessian on its initial sublevel converges to the unique
minimizer, and its gradient norms converge to zero. The weak Wolfe
coefficients are arbitrary fixed admissible coefficients.
items.title: existsUniqueLimitOfLocallyLipschitzHessian

items.label: fderiv_fderiv_eq_of_iteratedFDeriv_two_eq
items.statement:
Helper for eq:holder-hessian-bound: equality of second Fréchet derivatives follows
from equality of the corresponding second iterated derivatives.
items.title: fderiv_fderiv_eq_of_iteratedFDeriv_two_eq

items.label: freeCoefficientProductBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: absorption of the small current-step
term yields the product bound on the free secant coefficient.
items.title: freeCoefficientProductBound

items.label: freeCoefficientTendstoZero
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the secant-energy estimate and
vanishing step lengths force the nonnegative free coefficient to vanish.
items.title: freeCoefficientTendstoZero

items.label: gradientLowerBoundOfNonconvergence
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: a nonconvergent strongly convex
DFP orbit has gradient norms bounded uniformly away from zero.
items.title: gradientLowerBoundOfNonconvergence

items.label: gradientTangentCurvatureLower
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the Hessian lower bound
specializes to positive curvature in the unit tangent direction.
items.title: gradientTangentCurvatureLower

items.label: gradientTangentLogBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: for two nonzero gradients, the
rotated normalized-gradient increment and twice the log-norm increment
cancel up to the rotated secant pairing and a quadratic relative norm change.
items.title: gradientTangentLogBound

items.label: gradientTangentLogQuadraticBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: a quadratic gradient Taylor
remainder and quadratic normal step component give quadratic cancellation
between tangent transport and logarithmic gradient-norm change.
items.title: gradientTangentLogQuadraticBound

items.label: gradientUnitTangentNorm
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: at a nonstationary point, the
gradient tangent has unit norm.
items.title: gradientUnitTangentNorm

items.label: gradientZeroOfGlobalMinimizer
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: a global minimizer has zero
gradient, by Fermat's theorem and the canonical gradient-dual identity.
items.title: gradientZeroOfGlobalMinimizer

items.label: hessianLipschitzOnInitialSublevel
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: local Lipschitz Hessian regularity
on a compact initial sublevel yields one finite Lipschitz constant there.
items.title: hessianLipschitzOnInitialSublevel

items.label: holderExponent_le_half_of_planarSecantResidual
items.statement:
Helper for eq:counterexample-nonlipschitz: a planar secant residual of size
`εₖ‖sₖ‖`, together with `‖sₖ‖/εₖ² → C > 0`, cannot satisfy a Hölder remainder
bound of order `1 + β` when `β > 1/2`.
items.title: holderExponent_le_half_of_planarSecantResidual

items.label: holder_of_disjoint_finsum_hessian
items.statement:
Helper for eq:holder-hessian-bound: disjoint shrinking bumps with a uniform local
square-root Hessian modulus have the same modulus after zero-extension.
items.title: holder_of_disjoint_finsum_hessian

items.label: innerPerpSelf
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: right-angle rotation is
orthogonal to its argument.
items.title: innerPerpSelf

items.label: logDeterminantQuadraticRemainder
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: after the first-order terms are
removed, the logarithmic determinant increment has a quadratic remainder.
items.title: logDeterminantQuadraticRemainder

items.label: logOneAddQuadraticRemainder
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the logarithm has a uniform quadratic
remainder on the half-unit interval.
items.title: logOneAddQuadraticRemainder

items.label: logReciprocalQuadraticRemainder
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the reciprocal correction cancels
the linear term of the logarithm, leaving a uniform quadratic remainder.
items.title: logReciprocalQuadraticRemainder

items.label: longitudinalGradientBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the new gradient's component
along a normalized old step is small whenever descent and secants have quadratic-scale bounds.
items.title: longitudinalGradientBound

items.label: min_scaled_le_sqrt
items.statement:
Helper for eq:holder-hessian-bound: the minimum of a uniform size bound and an
inverse-scale Lipschitz bound has the square-root interpolation estimate used in the bump sum.
items.title: min_scaled_le_sqrt

items.label: normNormalResidual
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the distance from a planar step
to its tangential projection is its normal component's absolute value.
items.title: normNormalResidual

items.label: norm_euclideanHessian_sub_eq_norm_secondFDeriv_sub
items.statement:
Helper for eq:holder-hessian-bound: the Euclidean-plane Hessian norm of a difference
agrees with the norm of the corresponding difference of second Fréchet derivatives.
items.title: norm_euclideanHessian_sub_eq_norm_secondFDeriv_sub

items.label: norm_hessian_sub_le_of_thirdFDeriv
items.statement:
Helper for eq:holder-hessian-bound: a uniform third-derivative bound yields a
Lipschitz estimate for the second Fréchet derivative.
items.title: norm_hessian_sub_le_of_thirdFDeriv

items.label: norm_iteratedFDeriv_three_scaledLinearBump_le
items.statement:
Helper for eq:holder-hessian-bound: the third derivative of a scaled linear bump
is controlled by the third and second derivatives of its cutoff, with the expected
quadratic inverse-scale factor.
items.title: norm_iteratedFDeriv_three_scaledLinearBump_le

items.label: normalizationDifferenceBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: normalization is Lipschitz
between vectors whose norms have a common positive lower bound.
items.title: normalizationDifferenceBound

items.label: normalizedDeterminantLogIncrement
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the normalized determinant recurrence
has precisely the logarithmic form used in the corrected invariant.
items.title: normalizedDeterminantLogIncrement

items.label: normalizedIncrementLogBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the exact normalized increment
and logarithmic amplitude increment cancel to quadratic order.
items.title: normalizedIncrementLogBound

items.label: normalizedIncrementPairingIdentity
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: normalized vector increments have
an exact finite-difference identity that isolates the tangent cancellation.
items.title: normalizedIncrementPairingIdentity

items.label: normalizedOrbitCurvatureLowerBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the normalized secant curvature
of every physical DFP step is bounded below by the strong-convexity constant.
items.title: normalizedOrbitCurvatureLowerBound

items.label: normalizedOrbitSecantEquation
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: normalizing the displacement and
gradient change by the same step length preserves the exact secant equation.
items.title: normalizedOrbitSecantEquation

items.label: normalizedPerpIncrement
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: rotating a normalized gradient
increment gives the exact normalization identity used by tangent cancellation.
items.title: normalizedPerpIncrement

items.label: normalizedSecantCurvature
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: simultaneous secant normalization
expresses curvature as the secant pairing divided by squared step length.
items.title: normalizedSecantCurvature

items.label: normalizedSecantFirstOrderCancellation
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the first-order secant-vector
variation cancels from twice the curvature increment minus the quadratic
form increment.
items.title: normalizedSecantFirstOrderCancellation

items.label: normalizedStepFrameOrthogonal
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: normalizing a nonzero step gives
an orthogonal frame with that step as its first direction.
items.title: normalizedStepFrameOrthogonal

items.label: normalizedStepNormalBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the normalized physical step
has a small normal component under the quadratic descent bound.
items.title: normalizedStepNormalBound

items.label: not_hessianHolderOn_of_secantResidual
items.statement:
Helper for eq:counterexample-nonlipschitz: exact secant residuals of the
counterexample prohibit a Hölder Hessian of exponent greater than one half
on any convex set containing the secant endpoints.
items.title: not_hessianHolderOn_of_secantResidual

items.label: not_holderRemainder_of_quadraticStepBound
items.statement:
Helper for eq:counterexample-nonlipschitz: a residual of size `εₖ ℓₖ`
with positive steps `ℓₖ ≤ D εₖ²` rules out a remainder of order `1 + β`
when `β > 1/2`. Only an upper step bound is needed.
items.title: not_holderRemainder_of_quadraticStepBound

items.label: not_summable_correctedLogIncrements
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: under the nonconvergent-orbit energy
estimate, no vanishing correction can make the corrected log increments
absolutely summable while the positive gradient norms remain bounded above.
items.title: not_summable_correctedLogIncrements

items.label: not_tendsto_zero_of_eventually_positive_lower_bound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: a positive eventual lower bound is
incompatible with the degeneration of the free secant coefficient to zero.
items.title: not_tendsto_zero_of_eventually_positive_lower_bound

items.label: objectiveGapBoundByGradient
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the global Hessian lower bound
controls every objective gap by the squared gradient norm.
items.title: objectiveGapBoundByGradient

items.label: objectiveLowerBoundOfHessian
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: a global positive Hessian lower
bound supplies an explicit global lower bound for the objective.
items.title: objectiveLowerBoundOfHessian

items.label: objectiveValuesHaveLimit
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: objective values along an admissible
DFP sequence decrease to a finite limit bounded above by every iterate value.
items.title: objectiveValuesHaveLimit

items.label: operatorUnitVectorVariation
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: variations of a unit tangent
and a bounded linear operator control the variation of their product.
items.title: operatorUnitVectorVariation

items.label: orbitCorrectedLogIncrementBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the corrected logarithmic
quantity on the actual DFP orbit has uniformly quadratic eventual increments.
items.title: orbitCorrectedLogIncrementBound

items.label: orbitCorrectedLogIncrementsSummable
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the absolute increments of
the actual corrected logarithmic quantity form a summable series.
items.title: orbitCorrectedLogIncrementsSummable

items.label: orbitDeterminantRecurrence
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the original DFP iteration has
the exact determinant ratio expressed in physical gradient and point differences.
items.title: orbitDeterminantRecurrence

items.label: orbitEnergyDirectionBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the weak-Wolfe upper descent
bound controls the actual inverse-Hessian energy relative to its direction norm.
items.title: orbitEnergyDirectionBound

items.label: orbitFreeCoefficientDegeneration
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: failure of convergence of the
actual planar DFP orbit forces its free secant coefficient to vanish, with
an eventual bound by the product of adjacent physical step lengths.
The index `k` here represents the paper's coefficient at iteration `k + 1`.
items.title: orbitFreeCoefficientDegeneration

items.label: orbitFreeCoefficientNormalizedRecurrence
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the actual free coefficient
satisfies the normalized determinant recurrence on the logarithm's local domain.
items.title: orbitFreeCoefficientNormalizedRecurrence

items.label: orbitFreeCoefficientPhysicalFormula
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the oriented free coefficient
has the same physical secant formula used by the degeneration theorem.
items.title: orbitFreeCoefficientPhysicalFormula

items.label: orbitFreeCoefficientPos
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: every free coefficient of the
positive-step strongly convex DFP orbit is strictly positive.
items.title: orbitFreeCoefficientPos

items.label: orbitFreeCoefficientTendstoZero
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the free coefficient in
oriented coordinates tends to zero under nonconvergence.
items.title: orbitFreeCoefficientTendstoZero

items.label: orbitGradientTaylorRemainder
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the actual gradient secants along
the DFP orbit have a uniform quadratic Hessian-linearization remainder.
items.title: orbitGradientTaylorRemainder

items.label: orbitHessianTangentVariationBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: local Lipschitz Hessian
regularity controls changes of its action on the actual unit tangent.
items.title: orbitHessianTangentVariationBound

items.label: orbitInverseHessianBoundedOfNonconvergence
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: if a strongly convex planar DFP
orbit fails to converge, its inverse-Hessian operators remain uniformly bounded.
items.title: orbitInverseHessianBoundedOfNonconvergence

items.label: orbitLogCorrectionTendstoZero
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the logarithmic correction
tends to zero because the coefficient stays bounded and the orientation error vanishes.
items.title: orbitLogCorrectionTendstoZero

items.label: orbitLogIncrementRemainderBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the actual logarithmic free
coefficient increment differs from its oriented secant-linear term by a
uniform multiple of the two adjacent squared step lengths.
items.title: orbitLogIncrementRemainderBound

items.label: orbitLongitudinalGradientBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: on the actual DFP orbit the
new gradient has a uniformly small component along the previous normalized step.
items.title: orbitLongitudinalGradientBound

items.label: orbitOrientedSecantApproximation
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: on the actual DFP orbit,
the canonically oriented step approximates the gradient tangent and the
oriented secant approximates its Hessian image, uniformly to first order in step length.
items.title: orbitOrientedSecantApproximation

items.label: orbitOrientedSecantVariationBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: both oriented normalized
secant vectors vary at the sum of adjacent step scales along the actual orbit.
items.title: orbitOrientedSecantVariationBound

items.label: orbitPlanarSecantFrameSpecification
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: in the previous-step frame, the
actual DFP matrix satisfies the standard planar secant equation.
items.title: orbitPlanarSecantFrameSpecification

items.label: orbitSecantCoefficientApproximation
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the oriented secant coefficient
approximates the Hessian tangent coefficient to first order along the actual orbit.
items.title: orbitSecantCoefficientApproximation

items.label: orbitSecantEquation
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the original DFP recurrence
implies the exact secant equation between actual point and gradient differences.
items.title: orbitSecantEquation

items.label: orbitSecantPairingPos
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: global strong convexity makes
the physical secant pairing strictly positive at every positive DFP step.
items.title: orbitSecantPairingPos

items.label: orbitSmallestEigenvalueTendstoZero
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: along a nonconvergent strongly convex
planar DFP orbit, the smallest ordered inverse-Hessian eigenvalue tends to zero.
items.title: orbitSmallestEigenvalueTendstoZero

items.label: orbitStepNormPos
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: every step of an infinite
positive-step DFP orbit is nonzero.
items.title: orbitStepNormPos

items.label: orbitTangentLogQuadraticBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: local Lipschitz Hessian regularity
gives the quadratic tangent-log cancellation estimate along every sufficiently
late step of the actual nonconvergent DFP orbit.
items.title: orbitTangentLogQuadraticBound

items.label: orbitTangentVariationBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the actual unit tangent changes
by at most a fixed multiple of the physical step length on a nonconvergent orbit.
items.title: orbitTangentVariationBound

items.label: orbitTransportCoefficientBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the correcting coefficient
field stays uniformly bounded along the actual DFP orbit.
items.title: orbitTransportCoefficientBound

items.label: orbitTransportCoefficientVariation
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the actual Hessian tangent
coefficient varies by at most a fixed multiple of physical step length.
items.title: orbitTransportCoefficientVariation

items.label: orientedOrbitCurvature
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: oriented orbit curvature is
exactly the original normalized gradient secant curvature.
items.title: orientedOrbitCurvature

items.label: orientedOrbitCurvatureLower
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: orienting the physical secant
preserves its positive curvature lower bound.
items.title: orientedOrbitCurvatureLower

items.label: orientedOrbitDeterminantRecurrence
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the actual DFP determinant
recurrence is unchanged by canonical secant orientation and normalization.
items.title: orientedOrbitDeterminantRecurrence

items.label: orientedOrbitOperatorSecantEquation
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the oriented matrix secant
equation also holds in the canonical Euclidean operator representation.
items.title: orientedOrbitOperatorSecantEquation

items.label: orientedOrbitSecantBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the bounded gradient secants
give a uniform bound for the actual oriented normalized secant vectors.
items.title: orientedOrbitSecantBound

items.label: orientedOrbitSecantEquation
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: orientation preserves the exact
secant equation for the actual inverse-Hessian sequence.
items.title: orientedOrbitSecantEquation

items.label: orientedOrbitSecantRatio
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the oriented normalized secant
ratio equals the physical DFP determinant ratio.
items.title: orientedOrbitSecantRatio

items.label: orientedOrbitStepNorm
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the canonically oriented physical
step direction has unit norm.
items.title: orientedOrbitStepNorm

items.label: orientedSecantTaylorBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: a common orientation sign
preserves the normalized secant equation and does not enlarge the Taylor remainder.
items.title: orientedSecantTaylorBound

items.label: orientedStepTangentBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: orienting the physical step
toward the level-set tangent gives an error linear in its step length.
items.title: orientedStepTangentBound

items.label: orientedUnitStepTangentBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: after orienting a planar unit
vector toward the tangent, its distance to that tangent is controlled by
twice its normal component, including either original step direction.
items.title: orientedUnitStepTangentBound

items.label: orthogonalCoordinatesAction
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the inverse-Hessian action
commutes with passage to orthonormal secant coordinates.
items.title: orthogonalCoordinatesAction

items.label: orthogonalCoordinatesActionNorm
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the physical search-direction
norm agrees with its expression in orthonormal secant coordinates.
items.title: orthogonalCoordinatesActionNorm

items.label: orthogonalCoordinatesDet
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: orthogonal coordinate changes
preserve the determinant used to define the free secant coefficient.
items.title: orthogonalCoordinatesDet

items.label: orthogonalCoordinatesEnergy
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the physical gradient energy
agrees with its expression in orthonormal secant coordinates.
items.title: orthogonalCoordinatesEnergy

items.label: orthogonalCoordinatesPosDef
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: orthogonal coordinate changes
preserve positive definiteness of the inverse Hessian.
items.title: orthogonalCoordinatesPosDef

items.label: orthogonalCoordinatesSecant
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the physical secant equation
transports to the corresponding equation in an orthonormal frame.
items.title: orthogonalCoordinatesSecant

items.label: orthogonalSecantFreeCoefficient
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the transverse matrix entry in
any secant-aligned orthonormal frame equals curvature times the physical determinant.
items.title: orthogonalSecantFreeCoefficient

items.label: orthogonalTranspose
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the transpose of an orthogonal
frame is orthogonal as well.
items.title: orthogonalTranspose

items.label: physicalOperatorNormBoundOfCoordinates
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: an operator norm bound in an
orthonormal coordinate system is also a bound in physical coordinates.
items.title: physicalOperatorNormBoundOfCoordinates

items.label: planarFrameCoordinates
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: coordinates in the canonical
planar frame are the two inner products with its columns.
items.title: planarFrameCoordinates

items.label: planarFrameFirstColumn
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the first column of the canonical
oriented planar frame is its defining vector.
items.title: planarFrameFirstColumn

items.label: planarFrameSecondColumn
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the second column of the canonical
oriented planar frame is the positively rotated defining vector.
items.title: planarFrameSecondColumn

items.label: planarNormLeCoordinateAbsSum
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the Euclidean norm of a planar
vector is bounded by the sum of its coordinate absolute values.
items.title: planarNormLeCoordinateAbsSum

items.label: planarNormalTangentDecomposition
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: any planar vector decomposes
exactly into its normal and positively oriented tangent components.
items.title: planarNormalTangentDecomposition

items.label: planarPhysicalSecantOperatorBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the physical inverse Hessian is
bounded in terms of its normalized secant curvature and determinant.
items.title: planarPhysicalSecantOperatorBound

items.label: planarSecantFrameSpecification
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: a unit planar step and its
secant vector give the standard secant equation in the step's oriented frame.
items.title: planarSecantFrameSpecification

items.label: planarSecantResidualNorm
items.statement:
Helper for eq:counterexample-nonlipschitz: in two dimensions, the residual of
the symmetric secant matrix `1 + εS` from the identity has Euclidean norm
`|ε|` times the norm of the secant step, where `S` exchanges the coordinates.
items.title: planarSecantResidualNorm

items.label: planarUnitComponentSquares
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: squared normal and tangent
components of a planar unit vector add to one.
items.title: planarUnitComponentSquares

items.label: pointTendstoOfObjectiveTendsto
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: convergence of objective values to
the minimum implies convergence of points, using the strong-convexity gap.
items.title: pointTendstoOfObjectiveTendsto

items.label: positiveLowerBoundOfCorrectedLog
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: summable increments of the corrected
logarithm, a vanishing correction, and an upper bound on the gradient norms
give a positive eventual lower bound for the free secant coefficient.
items.title: positiveLowerBoundOfCorrectedLog

items.label: positiveMatrixOperatorSymmetry
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: positive-definite matrices
act as symmetric operators on Euclidean space.
items.title: positiveMatrixOperatorSymmetry

items.label: quadraticRemainderOfLipschitzDerivative
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: a Lipschitz derivative on a segment
gives a uniform quadratic first-order remainder.
items.title: quadraticRemainderOfLipschitzDerivative

items.label: rawOrbitConvergence
items.statement:
thm:planar-convergence: from an arbitrary positive-definite
initial inverse Hessian, a classical planar DFP orbit satisfying fixed weak
Wolfe conditions converges to the unique minimizer of a globally strongly
convex C2 objective with locally Lipschitz Hessian on its initial sublevel.
The statement includes a stationary hit through the constant algebraic
continuation of the point sequence; later matrix positivity is not assumed.
items.title: rawOrbitConvergence

items.label: rawOrbitConvergenceOfC3
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the C3 specialization applies
to raw DFP trajectories with only initial positive definiteness.
items.title: rawOrbitConvergenceOfC3

items.label: rawOrbitConvergenceOfNeighborhood
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the manuscript's hypothesis of
a locally Lipschitz Hessian on an open neighborhood of the initial sublevel
implies the sublevel regularity used by the convergence proof.
items.title: rawOrbitConvergenceOfNeighborhood

items.label: rawOrbitConvergenceOfNonstationary
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the nonstationary raw orbit
converges using only initial positive definiteness, with all later
well-definedness conditions derived from the DFP and Wolfe equations.
items.title: rawOrbitConvergenceOfNonstationary

items.label: rawOrbitPositiveDefinite
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: initial positive definiteness
propagates along every nonstationary raw DFP orbit satisfying weak Wolfe.
items.title: rawOrbitPositiveDefinite

items.label: rawOrbitSecantCurvaturePos
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: a nonstationary raw DFP step
from a positive-definite matrix has strictly positive secant curvature under weak Wolfe.
items.title: rawOrbitSecantCurvaturePos

items.label: rawOrbitStationaryTail
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: after a raw orbit reaches a
stationary point, its algebraically continued point sequence remains there.
items.title: rawOrbitStationaryTail

items.label: realizedObjectiveHessianHolder
items.statement:
Helper for eq:holder-hessian-bound: adding the translated quadratic preserves the
one-half Hölder modulus of the concrete endpoint-bump Hessian.
items.title: realizedObjectiveHessianHolder

items.label: reciprocalCurvatureDifference
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: positive curvature lower bounds
control the difference of reciprocal curvatures.
items.title: reciprocalCurvatureDifference

items.label: relativeCurvatureIncrementBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the relative curvature
increment is controlled by the total secant variation when the secant change is small.
items.title: relativeCurvatureIncrementBound

items.label: relativeCurvatureIncrementSpec
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the relative curvature
increment recovers the next curvature exactly.
items.title: relativeCurvatureIncrementSpec

items.label: relativeGradientNormBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: a gradient secant bound and a
positive gradient lower bound control relative changes of gradient norm.
items.title: relativeGradientNormBound

items.label: relativeIncrementCancellation
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the first-order change in the
secant vector cancels exactly from the normalized determinant increment.
items.title: relativeIncrementCancellation

items.label: relativeQuadraticIncrementBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the relative quadratic-form
increment is uniformly controlled by the secant change and the operator norm.
items.title: relativeQuadraticIncrementBound

items.label: relativeQuadraticIncrementSpec
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: symmetry and the old secant
equation identify the new quadratic form with its relative increment.
items.title: relativeQuadraticIncrementSpec

items.label: scaledSecantQuotientDifference
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: dividing nearby bounded vectors
by uniformly positive curvatures preserves a quantitative variation bound.
items.title: scaledSecantQuotientDifference

items.label: secantActionDecomposition
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the secant-coordinate search
direction is the sum of its longitudinal and free-coefficient components.
items.title: secantActionDecomposition

items.label: secantActionNormBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the exact secant decomposition
bounds the search-direction norm by the longitudinal component and the free coefficient.
items.title: secantActionNormBound

items.label: secantActionUniformBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: uniformly bounded gradients and
secant tilts bound the matrix action by the old step scale plus the free coefficient.
items.title: secantActionUniformBound

items.label: secantBoundsAlongOrbit
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: on the actual DFP orbit, secant
norms and predicted decreases have common quadratic-scale bounds.
items.title: secantBoundsAlongOrbit

items.label: secantCoefficientApproximationBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: first-order direction and
secant-image errors give a first-order error in the correcting coefficient.
items.title: secantCoefficientApproximationBound

items.label: secantCurvaturePerturbation
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: perturbing both oriented secant
vectors gives their exact curvature increment.
items.title: secantCurvaturePerturbation

items.label: secantCurvatureVariation
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: curvature differences are
controlled by changes of the unit direction and its bounded secant image.
items.title: secantCurvatureVariation

items.label: secantEnergyLowerBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the transverse square gives a
lower bound on the secant-coordinate gradient energy.
items.title: secantEnergyLowerBound

items.label: secantEnergyLowerBoundOfGradientNorm
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: a nonvanishing gradient and a small
longitudinal component give a uniform multiple of the free coefficient as an energy lower bound.
items.title: secantEnergyLowerBoundOfGradientNorm

items.label: secantLogIncrementRemainderBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the logarithmic determinant
increment differs from its tangent-linear part by quadratic secant errors.
items.title: secantLogIncrementRemainderBound

items.label: secantLogIncrementUniformBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: uniform secant and operator
bounds make the logarithmic determinant error quadratic in total secant variation.
items.title: secantLogIncrementUniformBound

items.label: secantLongitudinal
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the longitudinal entry follows from
the first secant equation.
items.title: secantLongitudinal

items.label: secantMatrixRepresentation
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: in secant coordinates, the full matrix
is determined by the curvature, transverse secant component, and one free entry.
items.title: secantMatrixRepresentation

items.label: secantOffDiagonal
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: a symmetric planar secant matrix has
off-diagonal entry determined by its transverse entry and the secant vector.
items.title: secantOffDiagonal

items.label: secantOperatorNormBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the free secant coefficient
controls the Euclidean operator norm of the whole secant-coordinate matrix.
items.title: secantOperatorNormBound

items.label: secantQuadraticDecomposition
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the secant-coordinate quadratic
form splits into a nonnegative longitudinal square and a free-coefficient square.
items.title: secantQuadraticDecomposition

items.label: secantQuadraticPerturbation
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the old secant equation eliminates
the matrix from the two linear terms in a perturbed quadratic form.
items.title: secantQuadraticPerturbation

items.label: secantQuadraticRemainderBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the quadratic-form remainder
is bounded without any positive lower bound on the inverse Hessian.
items.title: secantQuadraticRemainderBound

items.label: secantSequenceDegeneration
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: uniform secant-coordinate
estimates yield an eventual product bound and vanishing of the free matrix entry.
items.title: secantSequenceDegeneration

items.label: secantTiltBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: a positive curvature lower bound
and a bound on the transverse secant control its normalized tilt.
items.title: secantTiltBound

items.label: stationaryPointMinimizes
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: every stationary point of the
globally strongly convex objective is a global minimizer. This verifies
the finite-termination branch independently of any infinite-orbit encoding.
items.title: stationaryPointMinimizes

items.label: stepNormTendstoZero
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the physical DFP step lengths tend
to zero, by square summability derived from strong convexity and Armijo.
items.title: stepNormTendstoZero

items.label: stepNormalResidualBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the descent bound makes the
normal part of the step quadratic in its length when the gradient stays nonzero.
items.title: stepNormalResidualBound

items.label: stepSquareBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: strong convexity and Armijo bound
the squared physical displacement by its predicted decrease.
items.title: stepSquareBound

items.label: sublevelRadiusBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: a strong-convexity sublevel set
lies in an explicit ball about its initial point.
items.title: sublevelRadiusBound

items.label: summableCostsOfDescent
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: a lower-bounded objective that
decreases by a fixed positive multiple of nonnegative costs has summable costs.
items.title: summableCostsOfDescent

items.label: summablePredictedDecrease
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the actual predicted decreases of
a positive-step weak-Wolfe DFP orbit are summable under a global positive
Hessian lower bound.
items.title: summablePredictedDecrease

items.label: summableStepSquares
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the squared physical step lengths
of the classical DFP orbit are summable.
items.title: summableStepSquares

items.label: tangentCoefficientCancellation
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the coefficient field annihilates
the rotated tangential Hessian image exactly.
items.title: tangentCoefficientCancellation

items.label: tangentCoefficientNormBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: positive tangential curvature
and a bounded Hessian give a uniform norm bound on the correcting coefficient.
items.title: tangentCoefficientNormBound

items.label: tangentCoefficientPairing
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the coefficient field pairs
with the unit tangent to give exactly two.
items.title: tangentCoefficientPairing

items.label: tangentCoefficientSecantBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the tangential secant term cancels
and only the Taylor remainder and departure from a tangent step remain.
items.title: tangentCoefficientSecantBound

items.label: tangentDifferenceBound
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: right-angle rotation preserves
the Lipschitz estimate for the normalized gradient tangent.
items.title: tangentDifferenceBound

items.label: tangentOrientationAbs
items.statement: Helper for thm:planar-convergence: tangent orientation preserves norms.
items.title: tangentOrientationAbs

items.label: tangentOrientationPairing
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: orientation replaces the
tangential component by its absolute value.
items.title: tangentOrientationPairing

items.label: tangentOrientationSign
items.statement: Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the tangent orientation is a sign.
items.title: tangentOrientationSign

items.label: tendstoMinimizerOfLocallyLipschitzHessian
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: the corrected logarithmic
quantity rules out nonconvergence of a planar DFP orbit with locally Lipschitz Hessian.
items.title: tendstoMinimizerOfLocallyLipschitzHessian

items.label: transverseEntry_eq_curvature_mul_det
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the free transverse entry is the
secant curvature times the determinant, rather than an eigenvalue.
items.title: transverseEntry_eq_curvature_mul_det

items.label: transversePairingLowerBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: a bounded secant tilt and a small
longitudinal gradient component force a lower bound on the transverse pairing.
items.title: transversePairingLowerBound

items.label: uniformDifferentialBoundsOnSublevel
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: on the compact initial sublevel,
both the gradient and the Hessian have a common finite positive norm bound.
items.title: uniformDifferentialBoundsOnSublevel

items.label: variationBoundOfApproximation
items.statement:
Helper for thm:planar-convergence: pointwise first-order
approximation and controlled target variation give controlled approximant variation.
items.title: variationBoundOfApproximation

items.label: gradientInnerDisplacementNeg
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: a positive secant step length and a positive-definite
inverse Hessian make the actual displacement a strict descent step.
items.title: gradientInnerDisplacementNeg

items.label: gradientLowerBoundOfNonconvergence
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: a nonconvergent strongly convex
secant orbit has gradient norms bounded uniformly away from zero.
items.title: gradientLowerBoundOfNonconvergence

items.label: mem_objectiveSublevel_iff
items.statement: Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: sublevel membership is an objective inequality.
items.title: mem_objectiveSublevel_iff

items.label: normalizedOrbitCurvatureLowerBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the normalized secant curvature
of every physical secant step is bounded below by the strong-convexity constant.
items.title: normalizedOrbitCurvatureLowerBound

items.label: normalizedOrbitSecantEquation
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: normalizing the displacement and
gradient change by the same step length preserves the exact secant equation.
items.title: normalizedOrbitSecantEquation

items.label: objectiveSuccLeOfWeakWolfe
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: Armijo along a positive inverse-form secant step makes the
objective value nonincreasing at that step.
items.title: objectiveSuccLeOfWeakWolfe

items.label: objectiveValuesAntitoneOfWeakWolfe
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: positive inverse-form secant weak-Wolfe steps make the
objective values along the whole trajectory antitone.
items.title: objectiveValuesAntitoneOfWeakWolfe

items.label: objectiveValuesHaveLimit
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: objective values along an admissible
secant sequence decrease to a finite limit bounded above by every iterate value.
items.title: objectiveValuesHaveLimit

items.label: orbitEnergyDirectionBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the weak-Wolfe upper descent
bound controls the actual inverse-Hessian energy relative to its direction norm.
items.title: orbitEnergyDirectionBound

items.label: orbitFreeCoefficientDegeneration
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: failure of convergence of the
actual planar secant orbit forces its free secant coefficient to vanish, with
an eventual bound by the product of adjacent physical step lengths.
The index `k` here represents the paper's coefficient at iteration `k + 1`.
items.title: orbitFreeCoefficientDegeneration

items.label: orbitInverseHessianBoundedOfNonconvergence
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: if a strongly convex planar secant
orbit fails to converge, its inverse-Hessian operators remain uniformly bounded.
items.title: orbitInverseHessianBoundedOfNonconvergence

items.label: orbitLongitudinalGradientBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: on the actual secant orbit the
new gradient has a uniformly small component along the previous normalized step.
items.title: orbitLongitudinalGradientBound

items.label: orbitPlanarSecantFrameSpecification
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: in the previous-step frame, the
actual secant matrix satisfies the standard planar secant equation.
items.title: orbitPlanarSecantFrameSpecification

items.label: orbitSecantEquation
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the secant hypothesis gives the exact
relation between point and gradient differences.
items.title: orbitSecantEquation

items.label: orbitStepNormPos
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: every step of an infinite
positive-step secant orbit is nonzero.
items.title: orbitStepNormPos

items.label: orderedEigenvaluesCongr
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: equal Hermitian matrices have equal
ordered eigenvalue lists, independently of their Hermitian certificates.
items.title: orderedEigenvaluesCongr

items.label: pointMemObjectiveSublevelOfWeakWolfe
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: every point of a positive-step inverse-form secant
weak-Wolfe trajectory stays in its initial objective sublevel set.
items.title: pointMemObjectiveSublevelOfWeakWolfe

items.label: secantBoundsAlongOrbit
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: on the actual secant orbit, secant
norms and predicted decreases have common quadratic-scale bounds.
items.title: secantBoundsAlongOrbit

items.label: smallestEigenvalueSquareBound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the square of the smallest eigenvalue
of a positive-definite planar matrix is at most its determinant.
items.title: smallestEigenvalueSquareBound

items.label: smallestEigenvalueTendstoZero
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: nonconvergence forces the smallest
ordered eigenvalue of the secant matrices to tend to zero.
items.title: smallestEigenvalueTendstoZero

items.label: stepNormTendstoZero
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the physical secant step lengths tend
to zero, by square summability derived from strong convexity and Armijo.
items.title: stepNormTendstoZero

items.label: summablePredictedDecrease
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the actual predicted decreases of
a positive-step weak-Wolfe secant orbit are summable under a global positive
Hessian lower bound.
items.title: summablePredictedDecrease

items.label: summableStepSquares
items.statement:
Helper for lem:planar-degeneration: the squared physical step lengths
of the classical secant orbit are summable.
items.title: summableStepSquares

items.label: canonicalFactorization
items.statement:
Locally at `(0, 2, 1)` away from `ε = 0`, canonical recovery yields radius
`ε ^ 2 * ℛ₂` and shape `p₂`.
items.title: canonicalFactorization

items.label: coordinates_analyticAt
items.statement:
The complete pair of second-leg gradient coordinates in the canonical frame is real analytic
at the common base point.
items.title: coordinates_analyticAt

items.label: coordinates_contDiffAt
items.statement: The second-leg coordinate pair is `C^k` at the common base point for every order `k`.
items.title: coordinates_contDiffAt

items.label: coordinates_continuousAt
items.statement:
The complete pair of second-leg gradient coordinates in the canonical frame
is continuous at the common zero-scale base point.
items.title: coordinates_continuousAt

items.label: factorsAnalytic
items.statement: All six removable second-leg factors are jointly real analytic at `(0, 2, 1)`.
items.title: factorsAnalytic

items.label: factorsBase
items.statement:
The second-leg spectral, gradient, radius, and shape factors have base values
`(2, 1, 1, 2, 1, 2)`.
items.title: factorsBase

items.label: frameDiagonalization
items.statement:
Locally at `(0, 2, 1)`, the second-leg eigenframe diagonalizes the updated metric
with diagonal entries `ε ^ 4 * L₂` and `ℋ₂`.
items.title: frameDiagonalization

items.label: frameEntry_analyticAt
items.statement:
Every entry of the canonical second-leg eigenframe is real analytic at the common base

Locally at `(0, 2, 1)`, the second updated low and high eigenvalues factor as

items.label: firstEndpointAngleIncrement_toReal_eq_arctan_sub_eventually

of the outgoing and incoming gradient-slope arctangents.

endpoint-gradient angle increment is `-ε ^ 2 + o(ε ^ 2)`.

The final slope written in the removable first-leg spectral and gradient

quotient by multiplication with the approximate denominator.

modulo `ε^n`.

order-six finite Taylor jet.

Along the polynomial slow-graph path, the initial normalized gradient norm has the
displayed order-five finite Taylor jet.
items.title: slowInitialGradient

items.title: slowInitialGradientRemainder

Along the polynomial slow-graph path, the intermediate normalized gradient norm has the

Along the polynomial slow-graph path, the second normalized step norm has the displayed
order-six finite Taylor jet.

items.label: uniformOn
items.statement:
The five normalized step- and gradient-norm projections have one common order-seven
uniform finite-jet family on every closed ball of graph coefficients.
items.title: uniformOn

items.label: adjacentEndpointDistanceUpper
items.statement:
Consecutive flattened endpoints of every sufficiently small orbit carried
by an invariant slow curve are at most a constant times the endpoint radius.
items.title: adjacentEndpointDistanceUpper

items.label: bumpCorrectionContDiffTwoAndZeroJets
items.statement:
An invariant slow curve admits a common small-scale threshold on which the
endpoint-bump correction is twice continuously differentiable and has zero
value, gradient, and Hessian on its limiting circle.
items.title: bumpCorrectionContDiffTwoAndZeroJets

items.label: bumpCorrectionExtension
items.statement:
The endpoint-bump correction along an invariant slow curve is globally twice
continuously differentiable, vanishes on its limiting circle, interpolates the prescribed
endpoint jets, and has Hessian norm bounded linearly by the initial scale.
items.title: bumpCorrectionExtension

items.label: bumpCorrectionHessianBound
items.statement:
The Hessian norm of the endpoint-bump correction along an invariant slow curve is
bounded globally by a constant times the initial scale, uniformly over sufficiently small
initial scales.
items.title: bumpCorrectionHessianBound

items.label: endpointArmijo
items.statement:
Every sufficiently small endpoint step of an invariant slow-curve orbit
satisfies the scalar Armijo condition with coefficient `1 / 4`.
items.title: endpointArmijo

items.label: endpointArmijo_of_lt_two_thirds
items.statement:
Infrastructure I.16a: the endpoint Armijo inequality inherits any coefficient
`c₁` in the open interval `(0, 2 / 3)` from the uniform phase estimate.
items.title: endpointArmijo_of_lt_two_thirds

items.label: endpointBumpNormalizedJetBounds
items.statement:
Along an invariant slow curve, endpoint-bump values and first derivatives,
normalized by distance to the limiting circle, and second derivatives satisfy
uniform bounds at their respective powers of the cycle scale.
items.title: endpointBumpNormalizedJetBounds

items.label: endpointBumpSecondOrderJetsVanish
items.statement:
The normalized value, normalized first derivative, and second derivative
of endpoint bumps along an invariant slow curve vanish uniformly and
simultaneously as their supports approach the limiting circle.
items.title: endpointBumpSecondOrderJetsVanish

items.label: endpointBumpUniformBounds
items.statement:
A common threshold and positive constants uniformly control the value,
first derivative, and second derivative of every endpoint bump on its support
along an invariant slow curve.
items.title: endpointBumpUniformBounds

items.label: endpointClusterPt_mem_limitCircle
items.statement:
Every cluster point of the endpoints of a sufficiently small invariant
slow-curve orbit belongs to its limiting circle.
items.title: endpointClusterPt_mem_limitCircle

items.label: interpolationBallsEventuallyNearLimitCircle
items.statement:
Along a sufficiently small invariant slow curve, every positive closed
thickening of the limiting circle eventually contains every interpolation
ball.
items.title: interpolationBallsEventuallyNearLimitCircle

items.label: interpolationClosedBallDisjointLimitCircle
items.statement:
Along a sufficiently small invariant slow curve, every closed
interpolation ball is disjoint from the limiting circle.
items.title: interpolationClosedBallDisjointLimitCircle

items.label: interpolationRadiusAndLimitCircleDistanceTendstoZero
items.statement:
Along a sufficiently small invariant slow curve, interpolation radii and
endpoint distances to the limiting circle both tend to zero.
items.title: interpolationRadiusAndLimitCircleDistanceTendstoZero

items.label: interpolationRadiusTendstoZero
items.statement:
Along a sufficiently small invariant slow curve, interpolation radii tend
to zero.
items.title: interpolationRadiusTendstoZero

items.label: interpolationRadiusUniformBounds
items.statement:
Along a sufficiently small invariant slow curve, every interpolation
radius is bounded above and below by positive multiples of the corresponding
endpoint radius.
items.title: interpolationRadiusUniformBounds

items.label: interpolationRadius_isBigO_endpointRadius
items.statement:
Along a sufficiently small invariant slow curve, interpolation radius is
big-O of endpoint radius.
items.title: interpolationRadius_isBigO_endpointRadius

items.label: interpolationRadius_pos
items.statement:
Along a sufficiently small invariant slow curve, every interpolation
radius is strictly positive.
items.title: interpolationRadius_pos

items.label: ofAsymptotics_high
items.statement:
An invariant slow curve bundled by `ofAsymptotics` retains its high
coordinate.
items.title: ofAsymptotics_high

items.label: ofAsymptotics_shape
items.statement:
An invariant slow curve bundled by `ofAsymptotics` retains its shape
coordinate.
items.title: ofAsymptotics_shape

items.label: pairwiseDisjointInterpolationClosedBalls
items.statement:
Along a sufficiently small invariant slow curve, the closed interpolation
balls form a pairwise-disjoint family.
items.title: pairwiseDisjointInterpolationClosedBalls

items.label: path_apply
items.statement: The invariant slow-curve path exposes its three coordinates.
items.title: path_apply

items.label: phaseCorrectionRatioUniformBound
items.statement:
Uniformly over both phases of an invariant slow curve, the endpoint
correction relative to predicted decrease is at most linear in the cycle
scale whenever the boundary centers converge.
items.title: phaseCorrectionRatioUniformBound

items.label: phaseDecreaseRatioLowerBound
items.statement:
A sufficiently small invariant slow-curve orbit has positive predicted
decrease and realized decrease ratio at least one half on both phases.
items.title: phaseDecreaseRatioLowerBound

items.label: phaseDecreaseRatioLowerBound_of_lt_two_thirds
items.statement:
Infrastructure I.16a: the realized decrease ratio approaches the two-phase
limit from below uniformly for every first Wolfe coefficient strictly below
`2 / 3`.
items.title: phaseDecreaseRatioLowerBound_of_lt_two_thirds

items.label: phasePredictedDecreaseUniformBounds
items.statement:
Uniformly over both phases of an invariant slow curve, predicted decrease
is bounded above and below by positive multiples of the squared endpoint
radius.
items.title: phasePredictedDecreaseUniformBounds

items.label: phaseStepNormUniformBounds
items.statement:
Uniformly over both phases of an invariant slow curve, every physical
step norm is bounded above and below by positive multiples of the endpoint
radius.
items.title: phaseStepNormUniformBounds

items.label: phaseStepRatioUniformBound
items.statement:
Uniformly over both phases of an invariant slow curve, the
squared-step-to-decrease ratio differs from the prescribed phase ratio by at
most a positive constant times the cycle scale.
items.title: phaseStepRatioUniformBound

items.label: realizedObjectiveHolderSharp
items.statement:
Helper for eq:counterexample-nonlipschitz: sufficiently small realizations
of an invariant slow curve have a globally one-half Hölder Hessian and no
larger Hölder exponent on any convex set containing their endpoints.
items.title: realizedObjectiveHolderSharp

items.label: scaleTendstoZero
items.statement:
The scale coordinate of every sufficiently small forward state-map orbit
carried by an invariant slow curve tends to zero.
items.title: scaleTendstoZero

items.label: stateMap_path_eventuallyEq
items.statement:
Applying the two-leg state map along an invariant slow curve eventually
agrees with reparametrization by the next scale.
items.title: stateMap_path_eventuallyEq

items.label: stateScaleTendstoZero
items.statement:
The physical state scale along every sufficiently small orbit carried by
an invariant slow curve tends to zero.
items.title: stateScaleTendstoZero

items.label: supportInfDistBoundsUniformInSupport
items.statement:
Below one slow-curve threshold, a single pair of comparison constants works
for every family supported in the interpolation balls of the same orbit.
items.title: supportInfDistBoundsUniformInSupport

items.label: supportInfDistLinearLower
items.statement:
Compatibility certificate combining the pure support-distance lower bound
with the scale interval and interpolation-radius positivity used by downstream
decay estimates.
items.title: supportInfDistLinearLower

items.label: supportInfDistLinearLowerBound
items.statement:
For a sufficiently small invariant slow curve, every family supported in
the interpolation balls stays at least a fixed positive multiple of the cycle
scale away from the limiting circle, uniformly over every index.
items.title: supportInfDistLinearLowerBound

items.label: supportInfDistUniformBounds
items.statement:
For any one family supported in the interpolation balls of a sufficiently
small invariant slow-curve orbit, distance from support points to the limiting
circle is eventually comparable to the current cycle scale.

This compatibility form follows from `supportInfDistBoundsUniformInSupport`,
whose constants are chosen before the support family.
items.title: supportInfDistUniformBounds

items.label: amplitudeRatio_sub_quartic_isBigO

On any fifth-order slow graph, the normalized amplitude ratio differs
from its quartic model by a fifth-order remainder.
items.title: amplitudeRatio_sub_quartic_isBigO

items.label: eventually_gradientNorms_mem_Icc

Every open interval containing one eventually contains both normalized
gradient norms along a slow graph.
items.title: eventually_gradientNorms_mem_Icc

items.label: gradientNorms_tendsto

The initial and intermediate normalized-gradient norms converge jointly to
`(1, 1)` along a slow graph.
items.title: gradientNorms_tendsto

the polynomial slow graph through a normed-space-valued observable.
items.title: map_sub_map_jet_isBigO

items.label: map_sub_map_jet_isBigO_of_hasStrictFDerivAt

slow graph through a normed-space-valued map.
items.title: map_sub_map_jet_isBigO_of_hasStrictFDerivAt

items.label: ofAsymptotics_high

items.label: ofAsymptotics_shape

items.title: path_sub_jet_isBigO

`(0, 2, 1)`.
items.title: analyticAt_signedEpsilon

items.statement:
The canonical two-leg state map has a locally forward-invariant `C^7` graph

items.label: slowCurveAmplitudeDriftLittleO
items.statement:
Along a graph with the prescribed slow-curve jets, the normalized amplitude-ratio
remainder after its fourth-order term is little-o of `ε ^ 4` at zero.
items.title: slowCurveAmplitudeDriftLittleO

items.label: slowCurveFactorsUniformlyPositive
items.statement:
Along every sufficiently small orbit on an invariant slow graph, the ten removable
factors from the two legs share a strictly positive lower bound.
items.title: slowCurveFactorsUniformlyPositive

items.label: slowCurveForwardOrbitOnGraph
items.statement:
Every forward iterate of a sufficiently small positive point on an invariant
slow graph remains on that graph, with positive scale no larger than its initial scale.
items.title: slowCurveForwardOrbitOnGraph

items.label: slowCurveForwardOrbitPos
items.statement:
Every forward iterate of a sufficiently small positive point on an
invariant slow graph has positive scale and positive graph coordinates.
items.title: slowCurveForwardOrbitPos

items.label: slowCurveFourthPowerTailAsymptotic
items.statement:
Uniformly over sufficiently small positive orbits on an invariant slow graph,
the fourth-power tail has leading term `(2 / 3) * ε j`, with relative error
controlled by a nonnegative monotone right-hand modulus tending to zero.
items.title: slowCurveFourthPowerTailAsymptotic

items.label: slowCurveFourthPowerTailIsEquivalent
items.statement:
Along every sufficiently small positive orbit on an invariant slow graph, the
shifted fourth-power tail is asymptotic to `(2 / 3) * ε j`.
items.title: slowCurveFourthPowerTailIsEquivalent

items.label: slowCurveNextPosLt
items.statement:
Fixed fifth-order slow-graph jets make the signed two-leg scale update
positive and strictly smaller than the current scale near zero.
items.title: slowCurveNextPosLt

items.label: slowCurvePowerTailBounds
items.statement:
Every sufficiently small positive orbit on an invariant slow graph has
uniformly bounded fourth- and sixth-power tails.
items.title: slowCurvePowerTailBounds

items.label: slowCurveRecoveryDenominatorsUniformlyPositive
items.statement:
Along every sufficiently small orbit on an invariant slow graph, the four
canonical recovery denominators share a strictly positive lower bound.
items.title: slowCurveRecoveryDenominatorsUniformlyPositive

items.label: slowCurveScaleAsymptotic
items.statement:
Along every sufficiently small positive orbit on an invariant slow graph with the
prescribed fifth-order jets, the scale is asymptotic to `((9 / 2) * j) ^ (-1 / 3)`.
items.title: slowCurveScaleAsymptotic

items.label: slowCurveScaleFourthPowerSummable
items.statement:
Along every sufficiently small positive orbit on an invariant slow graph with the
prescribed fifth-order jets, the fourth powers of the scale form a summable series.
items.title: slowCurveScaleFourthPowerSummable

items.label: slowCurveScaleSquareNotSummable
items.statement:
Along every sufficiently small positive orbit on an invariant slow graph with the
prescribed fifth-order jets, the square powers of the scale do not form a summable series.
items.title: slowCurveScaleSquareNotSummable

items.label: slowCurveSixthPowerTailIsBigO
items.statement:
Along every sufficiently small positive orbit on an invariant slow graph, the
shifted sixth-power tail is `O(ε j ^ 3)` at `atTop`.
items.title: slowCurveSixthPowerTailIsBigO

items.label: slowCurveSpectraSimple
items.statement:
Along every sufficiently small orbit on an invariant slow graph, both eigenvalues
of each leg's output metric have algebraic multiplicity one.
items.title: slowCurveSpectraSimple

items.label: slowGraphAmplitudeRemainderDirect
items.statement:
Along the polynomial slow graph, the normalized amplitude equals its stated
degree-seven polynomial up to `O(ε ^ 8)`, independently of the legacy theorem.
items.title: slowGraphAmplitudeRemainderDirect

items.label: slowGraphFirstLegFactorGerms
items.statement:
The four first-leg removable factors have their order-eight germs along the
polynomial slow graph.
items.title: slowGraphFirstLegFactorGerms

items.label: slowGraphJetPath_apply
items.statement: The three coordinates of the polynomial slow-graph approximation.
items.title: slowGraphJetPath_apply

items.label: slowGraphJetPath_tendsto
items.statement:
The canonical polynomial slow-graph path converges to the canceled base
state.
items.title: slowGraphJetPath_tendsto

items.label: slowGraphNormalizedRadiusJet
items.statement:
Along the polynomial slow graph, the normalized radius factor has
order-four jet `1 - 3 * ε ^ 3 + (5 / 2) * ε ^ 4`.
items.title: slowGraphNormalizedRadiusJet

items.label: slowGraphRawFrameGerms
items.statement:
Along the polynomial slow graph, the first- and second-leg raw frame
off-diagonal entries and high-minus-low entries have these order-eight germs.
items.title: slowGraphRawFrameGerms

items.label: slowGraphSecondLegAmplitudeGerm
items.statement:
The removable low second-leg gradient factor has its order-eight germ along
the polynomial slow graph.
items.title: slowGraphSecondLegAmplitudeGerm

items.label: slowGraphSignedRecurrence
items.statement:
A perturbation of the polynomial slow graph by `O(ε ^ 5)` yields the
signed recurrence `ε₊ = ε - (3 / 2) * ε ^ 4 + (5 / 4) * ε ^ 5 + O(ε ^ 6)`.
items.title: slowGraphSignedRecurrence

items.label: slowGraphSignedRecurrenceBound
items.statement:
For a slow graph with the fixed cubic and quartic jets, one positive
threshold and coefficient bound the signed two-leg recurrence remainder at
every smaller positive scale.
items.title: slowGraphSignedRecurrenceBound

items.label: slowGraphSignedRecurrenceModulus
items.statement:
The normalized signed recurrence remainder has the canonical order-five
tail-supremum modulus, uniformly controlled at a linear rate.
items.title: slowGraphSignedRecurrenceModulus

For a valid physical phase, the second displacement norm is the positive

vector is written as a base vector plus a fourth-order error.

If the vector perturbation is fourth order in a positive radius, the
oriented-angle error is bounded cubically in that radius.

A common positive norm lower bound turns a vector perturbation estimate into
