items.statement:
The order-nine derivative-constructed jets of all thirteen observable coordinates
are uniform on every bounded closed ball of graph coefficients.
items.title: uniformOn

items.label: observableJetsCommonDomain
items.statement:
On every bounded graph-coefficient set, one neighborhood simultaneously preserves
all factored-state and canonical branch margins and controls the common order-nine
remainder of the thirteen complete observable coordinates.
items.title: observableJetsCommonDomain

items.label: slowOrder_apply
items.statement:
Evaluation of the coordinatewise truncation orders for the slow-graph
observable jets.
items.title: slowOrder_apply

items.label: slowPolynomial_apply
items.statement:
Evaluation of the ordered polynomial models for the slow-graph
observable jets.
items.title: slowPolynomial_apply

items.label: slowGraphJets
items.statement:
Every coordinate of the complete two-leg observable along the polynomial
slow-graph path has its displayed polynomial jet at the strongest certified order.
items.title: slowGraphJets

items.label: observableBranchFactors_continuousAt
items.statement: Every observable branch margin is continuous at the common canceled base.
items.title: observableBranchFactors_continuousAt

items.label: observableBranchFactors_base
items.statement: Every observable branch margin is positive at the common canceled base.
items.title: observableBranchFactors_base

items.label: observableBranchFactorsCommonDomain
items.statement:
On a bounded closed coefficient ball, all five branch margins share one positive lower bound
throughout one common zero-scale neighborhood.
items.title: observableBranchFactorsCommonDomain

items.label: observableJetsCommonDomain_via_companions
items.statement:
On every bounded graph-coefficient set, one radius preserves all state and observable branch
margins and controls the common order-nine Taylor remainder.
items.title: observableJetsCommonDomain_via_companions

items.label: mixedAmplitudeCoefficientPolynomial
items.statement:
The displayed amplitude coefficient array evaluates to its constant plus
    quadratic polynomial.
items.title: mixedAmplitudeCoefficientPolynomial

items.label: mixedFrameAngleCoefficientPolynomial
items.statement:
The displayed frame-angle coefficient array evaluates to the linear polynomial
    `-3 * r`.
items.title: mixedFrameAngleCoefficientPolynomial

items.label: absPow_nat_eq_realRpow
items.statement: A natural power of an absolute value agrees with its real-power notation.
items.title: absPow_nat_eq_realRpow

items.label: mixedRawObservableStep_pair_eq
items.statement:
The metric and gradient projections of a physical raw step are the corresponding
    independent raw-step projections; only the third displacement component is extra.
items.title: mixedRawObservableStep_pair_eq

items.label: mixedRawObservableStep_metric_eq
items.statement: The physical raw-step metric is the independent raw-step metric.
items.title: mixedRawObservableStep_metric_eq

items.label: mixedRawObservableStep_gradient_eq
items.statement: The physical raw-step gradient is the independent raw-step gradient.
items.title: mixedRawObservableStep_gradient_eq

items.label: mixedObservable_amplitude_eq_independentRaw
items.statement: The physical amplitude equals the independent raw final low coordinate.
items.title: mixedObservable_amplitude_eq_independentRaw

items.label: mixedObservable_frameAngle_eq_independentRaw
items.statement: The physical frame increment equals the independent raw relative-frame coordinate.
items.title: mixedObservable_frameAngle_eq_independentRaw

items.label: independentRawStep_zeroRadius_base
items.statement: The zero-radius independent raw step is stationary at the diagonal base.
items.title: independentRawStep_zeroRadius_base

items.label: independentRawStep_zeroRadius_frame
items.statement: The zero-radius independent raw frame is the identity.
items.title: independentRawStep_zeroRadius_frame

items.label: independentRawStep_zeroRadius_conjugated
items.statement: Conjugating the zero-radius step by the stationary first frame changes nothing.
items.title: independentRawStep_zeroRadius_conjugated

items.label: rawObservableStep_gradientSub_eq_displacement_of_identity
items.statement: An identity secant matrix makes the raw gradient change equal its displacement.
items.title: rawObservableStep_gradientSub_eq_displacement_of_identity

items.label: rawObservableStep_gradient_eq_add_displacement_of_identity
items.statement: The identity step exposes its updated gradient as input plus displacement.
items.title: rawObservableStep_gradient_eq_add_displacement_of_identity

items.label: orientedLowCoordinate_eq_of_fixedFrameCoordinates
items.statement: A positive fixed-frame low coordinate is preserved by gradient orientation.
items.title: orientedLowCoordinate_eq_of_fixedFrameCoordinates

items.label: orientedLowCoordinate_eq_of_fixedFrameCoordinates_neg
items.statement: Simultaneous negation preserves a positive fixed-frame low coordinate.
items.title: orientedLowCoordinate_eq_of_fixedFrameCoordinates_neg

items.label: mixedRawObservableStep_displacement_eq
items.statement:
Under the usual secant-step side conditions, the physical raw displacement is the
    displacement field of the canonical abstract secant step.
items.title: mixedRawObservableStep_displacement_eq

items.label: rawObservableStep_negate_gradient
items.statement:
Negating an incoming raw gradient preserves the metric update and negates both
    the updated gradient and the displacement.
items.title: rawObservableStep_negate_gradient

items.label: mixedRawProjectionDomain_eventually
items.statement:
Near every bounded mixed parameter, either the radius is zero or all canonical
    raw-projection side conditions hold simultaneously.
items.title: mixedRawProjectionDomain_eventually

items.label: mixedIndependentSecondGradientLow_truncatedGerm
items.statement: The canonical second-leg low-gradient coordinate has the displayed uniform truncated germ.
items.title: mixedIndependentSecondGradientLow_truncatedGerm

items.label: mixedCenterBracket_zero
items.statement: The normalized mixed center bracket vanishes at the removable zero-radius base.
items.title: mixedCenterBracket_zero

items.label: weightedCenterBracket_neg_neg
items.statement:
Simultaneously negating an oriented frame and its second displacement leaves the
    weighted center bracket unchanged.
items.title: weightedCenterBracket_neg_neg

items.label: mixedRawProjectionDomain_uniformTube
items.statement:
A bounded mixed parameter set admits one common radius tube for the raw projection
    side conditions.
items.title: mixedRawProjectionDomain_uniformTube

items.label: mixedFirstDisplacement_denominator_pos
items.statement:
The first raw-step denominator is strictly positive on the punctured projection
    domain, so the first normalized displacement can be used without a removable
    denominator branch.
items.title: mixedFirstDisplacement_denominator_pos

items.label: centerResidual_factorization_of_removable_branches
items.statement:
Zero-control, zero-radius, and punctured residual identities imply an
    unconditional cubic factorization.
items.title: centerResidual_factorization_of_removable_branches

items.label: mixedObservableTruncatedGerms
items.statement:
The physical amplitude and frame-angle projections inherit their canonical
    independent-radius coefficient germs.
items.title: mixedObservableTruncatedGerms

items.label: localScalarCubicBound
items.statement:
A local cubic factorization and a bounded quotient imply the corresponding
    estimate on the same radius tube.
items.title: localScalarCubicBound

items.label: unscaledCenterResidual_uniformBound
items.statement:
The unscaled physical center residual has the prescribed mixed-variable cubic
    bound.
items.title: unscaledCenterResidual_uniformBound

items.label: amplitudeExpansion
items.statement:
Appendix Lemma A.6 (Mixed-variable physical drift expansion) (1): uniformly
    on a bounded mixed-parameter region, the amplitude ratio has its specified
    quadratic term with an order-three remainder in the independent radius.
items.title: amplitudeExpansion

items.label: frameAngleExpansion
items.statement:
Appendix Lemma A.6 (Mixed-variable physical drift expansion) (2): uniformly
    on a bounded mixed-parameter region, the real signed frame-angle increment
    is `-3 * r` up to an order-two remainder.
items.title: frameAngleExpansion

items.label: centerDisplacementExpansion
items.statement:
Appendix Lemma A.6 (Mixed-variable physical drift expansion) (3): uniformly
    on a bounded mixed-parameter region, the incoming-low-frame center
    displacement has its specified quadratic drift with a joint
    `G * |b| * |r| ^ 3` bound.
items.title: centerDisplacementExpansion

items.label: physicalAmplitudeTruncatedGerm_of_framePathCertificate
items.statement:
Appendix Lemma A.6: a pathwise signed-frame certificate transports the physical
amplitude to the explicit three-term independent-radius quadratic germ.
items.title: physicalAmplitudeTruncatedGerm_of_framePathCertificate

items.label: PhysicalAmplitudeFramePathCertificate.uncurry_eventuallyEq_secondGradientLow
items.statement:
Appendix Lemma A.6: a pathwise frame certificate yields the uncurried
physical-to-normalized amplitude equality required by germ transport.
items.title: PhysicalAmplitudeFramePathCertificate.uncurry_eventuallyEq_secondGradientLow

items.label: orientedEigenframe_eq_fixedFrame_of_positive_coordinate
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: a positive canonical low-frame coordinate selects the oriented
eigenframe without a global sign change.
items.title: orientedEigenframe_eq_fixedFrame_of_positive_coordinate

items.label: orientedEigenframe_lowCoordinate_eq_of_positive_coordinate
items.statement:
Appendix Lemma A.6 companion: the first oriented output coordinate equals its positive
canonical low-frame coordinate.
items.title: orientedEigenframe_lowCoordinate_eq_of_positive_coordinate

items.label: orientedEigenframe_lowCoordinate_eq_of_positive_negated_coordinate
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: the same orientation bridge is stable under a simultaneous
negation of the incoming vector and its canonical coordinates.
items.title: orientedEigenframe_lowCoordinate_eq_of_positive_negated_coordinate

items.label: physicalAmplitude_eq_mixedIndependentRawAmplitude_input
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: along the canonical mixed input, the physical
    amplitude equals the independent raw evaluator's final low coordinate.
items.title: physicalAmplitude_eq_mixedIndependentRawAmplitude_input

items.label: physicalAmplitude_eventuallyEq_secondGradientLow_of_rawCertificate
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: an eventual raw-to-normalized low-coordinate
    equality transports the physical amplitude to that normalized coordinate.
items.title: physicalAmplitude_eventuallyEq_secondGradientLow_of_rawCertificate

items.label: physicalAmplitude_uncurry_eventuallyEq_secondGradientLow_of_rawCertificate
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: a product-filter raw-coordinate certificate
    gives the uncurried physical-amplitude equality used by germ transport.
items.title: physicalAmplitude_uncurry_eventuallyEq_secondGradientLow_of_rawCertificate

items.label: HasQuadraticGerm.congr_of_eventuallyEq
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: a quadratic germ transports across an eventual
equality when the destination representative is continuous at the base point.
items.title: HasQuadraticGerm.congr_of_eventuallyEq

items.label: HasQuadraticGerm.to_quadraticRemainder
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: subtracting the quadratic model turns a
quadratic germ into an explicit third-order remainder germ.
items.title: HasQuadraticGerm.to_quadraticRemainder

items.label: physicalAmplitudeQuadraticGerm_of_componentTransport
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: the physical amplitude inherits the quadratic
germ computed from four spectral/gradient component germs.
items.title: physicalAmplitudeQuadraticGerm_of_componentTransport

items.label: physicalAmplitudeRemainder_of_componentTransport
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: the component transport directly supplies the
explicit third-order amplitude remainder consumed by physical-drift estimates.
items.title: physicalAmplitudeRemainder_of_componentTransport

items.label: independentRadiusSecondGradientLow_truncatedGerm
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: the normalized second-gradient low coordinate
    has a compact-uniform quadratic germ on any parameter set.
items.title: independentRadiusSecondGradientLow_truncatedGerm

items.label: physicalAmplitudeTruncatedGerm_of_secondGradientLow_rawCertificate
items.statement:
Appendix Lemma A.6: a raw-to-normalized second-gradient certificate yields
    the physical amplitude coefficient germ, with the exact displayed quadratic
    coefficient and no additional frame assumptions hidden in the conclusion.
items.title: physicalAmplitudeTruncatedGerm_of_secondGradientLow_rawCertificate

items.label: quadraticModel_continuousAt
items.statement: Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: every quadratic model is continuous at the origin.
items.title: quadraticModel_continuousAt

items.label: model
items.statement: Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: a quadratic model carries its own quadratic germ.
items.title: model

items.label: iteratedDeriv_two_eq_of_contDiffAt
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: a `C³` path with a quadratic germ has the
    corresponding second iterated derivative at the origin.
items.title: iteratedDeriv_two_eq_of_contDiffAt

items.label: congrFunction
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: a pointwise equal representative carries the same
quadratic germ.
items.title: congrFunction

items.label: congrCoefficients
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: equal coefficient triples describe the same
quadratic germ.
items.title: congrCoefficients

items.label: neg
items.statement: Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: quadratic germs are closed under negation.
items.title: neg

items.label: add
items.statement: Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: quadratic germs are closed under addition.
items.title: add

items.label: sub
items.statement: Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: quadratic germs are closed under subtraction.
items.title: sub

items.label: mul
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: multiplication convolves quadratic germ
coefficients and discards terms of order at least three.
items.title: mul

items.label: constMul
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: multiplication by a constant scales every
quadratic germ coefficient.
items.title: constMul

items.label: inv
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: the reciprocal of a nonvanishing quadratic germ
has the standard reciprocal coefficients.
items.title: inv

items.label: div
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: division by a nonvanishing quadratic germ is
multiplication by its reciprocal germ.
items.title: div

items.label: sqrtOne
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: the positive square root of a germ based at one
has coefficients obtained by solving the square equation through order two.
items.title: sqrtOne

items.label: recoveryRadiusQuadraticGerm_of_componentGerms
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: canonical spectral and gradient component germs
    determine the recovered radius factor through quadratic order.
items.title: recoveryRadiusQuadraticGerm_of_componentGerms

items.label: recoveryRadiusPathQuadraticGerm_of_componentGerms
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: multiplying the recovered radius factor by the
    independent radius shifts the same quadratic germ by one order.
items.title: recoveryRadiusPathQuadraticGerm_of_componentGerms

items.label: independentFirstResidualQuadraticGerms
items.statement:
Appendix Lemma A.6 companion: the five first-leg residual coordinates along the
independent-radius path have their explicit quadratic germs.
items.title: independentFirstResidualQuadraticGerms

items.label: quadraticModel_deriv_at_zero
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: the derivative of a quadratic model at the origin is
    its linear coefficient.
items.title: quadraticModel_deriv_at_zero

items.label: quadraticModel_iteratedDeriv_two_at_zero
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: the second iterated derivative of a quadratic model
    at the origin is twice its quadratic coefficient.
items.title: quadraticModel_iteratedDeriv_two_at_zero

items.label: HasQuadraticGerm.of_contDiffAt_iteratedDeriv_two
items.statement:
Appendix Lemma A.6 companion: a `C³` scalar path with prescribed value, first
    derivative, and second iterated derivative has the corresponding quadratic germ.
items.title: HasQuadraticGerm.of_contDiffAt_iteratedDeriv_two

items.label: HasQuadraticGerm.iteratedDeriv_coefficients_of_contDiffAt
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: under `C³` regularity, a quadratic germ exposes
    its value, first derivative, and second iterated derivative at the base point.
items.title: HasQuadraticGerm.iteratedDeriv_coefficients_of_contDiffAt

items.label: physicalAmplitudeQuadraticGerm_of_recoveredRadius
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: a physical amplitude equal near zero to the
    recovered independent-radius factor carries its concrete quadratic germ.
items.title: physicalAmplitudeQuadraticGerm_of_recoveredRadius

items.label: physicalAmplitudeRemainder_of_recoveredRadius
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: the same recovered-radius projection gives the
    explicit third-order remainder after subtracting its quadratic model.
items.title: physicalAmplitudeRemainder_of_recoveredRadius

items.label: physicalAmplitudeTruncatedGerm_of_recoveredRadius
items.statement:
Appendix Lemma A.6: eventual equality with the recovered-radius projection and joint
    `C³` regularity produce the three-term physical-amplitude germ needed for a cubic
    uniform remainder.
items.title: physicalAmplitudeTruncatedGerm_of_recoveredRadius

items.label: physicalAmplitudeRemainderOn_of_recoveredRadius
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: the physical-amplitude truncated germ yields the
    explicit compact-uniform cubic remainder used by the amplitude expansion.
items.title: physicalAmplitudeRemainderOn_of_recoveredRadius

items.label: HasQuadraticGerm.arctan_of_zero
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: composing a zero-based quadratic germ with
    `Real.arctan` preserves its constant, linear, and quadratic coefficients.
items.title: HasQuadraticGerm.arctan_of_zero

items.label: HasQuadraticGerm.of_eqModPow_of_order
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: an `EqModPow n` certificate with `3 ≤ n` is a
    quadratic germ once the source path is continuous at zero.
items.title: HasQuadraticGerm.of_eqModPow_of_order

items.label: independentRadiusTruncatedGerm_of_arctan_zero_slope
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: a zero-based scalar slope with first derivative
    `a` gives the arctangent coefficient germ `[0, a]` in the independent radius.
items.title: independentRadiusTruncatedGerm_of_arctan_zero_slope

items.label: centerResidual_factorization_of_branchCertificates
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: zero-scale, zero-radius, and punctured
    certificates assemble into one scalar cubic factorization.
items.title: centerResidual_factorization_of_branchCertificates

items.label: centerResidual_factorization_of_zeroRadius_and_punctured
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: the unconditional zero-radius identity can be combined with
the zero-scale and punctured certificates without repeating its proof at the call site.
items.title: centerResidual_factorization_of_zeroRadius_and_punctured

items.label: uncurryEventuallyEq_of_zeroOrCertificate
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: an eventual zero-radius-or-certificate
    decomposition transports a scalar family equality on the product filter.
items.title: uncurryEventuallyEq_of_zeroOrCertificate

items.label: canonicalFrameSlope_apply
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: the canonical slope evaluates to its
entry-wise quotient formula.
items.title: canonicalFrameSlope_apply

items.label: canonicalFrameSlope_eq_entryQuotient
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: the canonical slope is equal as a path to
its entry-wise quotient formula, which remains rewriteable across modules.
items.title: canonicalFrameSlope_eq_entryQuotient

items.label: canonicalFrameSlope_uncurry_eq_entryQuotient
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: the uncurried canonical slope has an
explicit entry quotient normal form for joint analytic arguments.
items.title: canonicalFrameSlope_uncurry_eq_entryQuotient

items.label: canonicalFrameSlope_analyticAt
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: the joint canonical slope is analytic at
each base point, with the removable denominator normalized at radius zero.
items.title: canonicalFrameSlope_analyticAt

items.label: canonicalFrameSlope_entryGerms
items.statement:
Infrastructure I.16a: the four public normal-form entry paths carry the
quadratic coefficients required by the raw-frame quotient.
items.title: canonicalFrameSlope_entryGerms

items.label: canonicalFrameSlope_contDiffAt_and_deriv_of_entryRegularity
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: `C²` certificates for the four canonical
entry paths complete the canonical slope's regularity and first-order law.
items.title: canonicalFrameSlope_contDiffAt_and_deriv_of_entryRegularity

items.label: contDiffAt_radiusSlice_of_analyticAt
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: an analytic function on the independent
radius parameter space restricts to a `C²` fixed-parameter radius slice.
items.title: contDiffAt_radiusSlice_of_analyticAt

items.label: canonicalFrameSlope_entryRegularity
items.statement:
Infrastructure I.16a: the public independent-radius metric and spectral
paths provide `C²` regularity for all four canonical quotient entries.
items.title: canonicalFrameSlope_entryRegularity

items.label: canonicalFrameSlope_contDiffAt_and_deriv
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: the canonical independent-radius slope is
`C²` at the base radius and has linear coefficient `-3`.
items.title: canonicalFrameSlope_contDiffAt_and_deriv

items.label: coordZeroJoint_contDiffAt_of_entryRegularity
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: entry regularity is preserved by the scalar weighted
center-bracket coordinate formula.
items.title: coordZeroJoint_contDiffAt_of_entryRegularity

items.label: coordZeroJoint_contDiffAt_of_analyticEntries
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: analytic entry certificates provide the joint
`C³` regularity required by the bracket remainder transport.
items.title: coordZeroJoint_contDiffAt_of_analyticEntries

items.label: canonicalCenterBracket_uncurry_eq_coordZeroJoint
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: the canonical bracket is definitionally represented by
the joint scalar coordinate normal form.
items.title: canonicalCenterBracket_uncurry_eq_coordZeroJoint

items.label: canonicalCenterBracket_contDiffAt_of_entryRegularity
items.statement:
Infrastructure I.16a: joint entry regularity gives joint `C³` regularity of the canonical
weighted center bracket.
items.title: canonicalCenterBracket_contDiffAt_of_entryRegularity

items.label: canonicalCenterBracket_contDiffAt_of_analyticEntries
items.statement:
Infrastructure I.16a: joint analytic entry certificates give the canonical bracket
regularity needed by `truncatedGerm_of_coordZero_quadraticGerm`.
items.title: canonicalCenterBracket_contDiffAt_of_analyticEntries

items.label: canonicalCenterBracket_quadraticGerm_of_scaleCertificate
items.statement:
Infrastructure I.16a: a common-scale germ certificate determines the quadratic germ of
the canonical weighted center bracket, leaving only the source scale quotient to be proved.
items.title: canonicalCenterBracket_quadraticGerm_of_scaleCertificate

items.label: centerBracket_linearPolynomial
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: the two-term truncated polynomial of a
bracket with zero constant coefficient is `κ θ * r`.
items.title: centerBracket_linearPolynomial

items.label: centerBracket_zeroFilledQuotient_uniformBound
items.statement:
Infrastructure I.16a: a compact quadratic bracket germ and its exact
`θ.1 * r` transport yield a uniform bound for the zero-filled cubic quotient.
items.title: centerBracket_zeroFilledQuotient_uniformBound

items.label: firstNormalizedDisplacement_coordinate_quadraticGerms
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: the canonical first normalized displacement has explicit
quadratic germs in both coordinate directions.
items.title: firstNormalizedDisplacement_coordinate_quadraticGerms

items.label: secondNormalizedDisplacement_coordinate_quadraticGerms_of_factorCertificate
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: a scalar second-leg factor germ and two coordinate
factor germs produce the quadratic germs of the normalized second displacement.
items.title: secondNormalizedDisplacement_coordinate_quadraticGerms_of_factorCertificate

items.label: canonicalFirstBracket_quadraticGerm
items.statement:
Infrastructure I.16a: concrete first-frame and first-displacement germs combine with
any second-displacement coordinate germs into the scalar weighted center-bracket germ.
items.title: canonicalFirstBracket_quadraticGerm

items.label: lowVector_coordinate_quadraticGerms
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: the first two coordinates of a symmetric-matrix
path are assembled into a quadratic germ for its low eigenvector.
items.title: lowVector_coordinate_quadraticGerms

items.label: lowFrame_entry_quadraticGerms
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: quadratic germs for a symmetric-matrix path determine all
four entries of its canonical low eigenframe at the diagonal base.
items.title: lowFrame_entry_quadraticGerms

items.label: independentRadiusFirstFrameQuadraticGerms
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: the independent-radius first metric triple
inherits a concrete quadratic germ for every canonical low-frame entry.
items.title: independentRadiusFirstFrameQuadraticGerms

items.label: independentRadiusSecondFrameQuadraticGerms
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: the independent-radius second metric triple
inherits a concrete quadratic germ for every canonical low-frame entry.
items.title: independentRadiusSecondFrameQuadraticGerms

items.label: exists_uniform_quotient_bound_of_continuousOn
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: a quotient continuous on the compact parameter
    tube has a uniform norm bound on every smaller radius interval.
items.title: exists_uniform_quotient_bound_of_continuousOn

items.label: exists_local_uniform_quotient_bound_of_continuousOn
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: continuity of a quotient on some positive
    compact parameter tube supplies the complete local uniform-bound certificate.
items.title: exists_local_uniform_quotient_bound_of_continuousOn

items.label: exists_local_uniform_quotient_bound_of_continuousKernel
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: a continuous kernel agreeing with the quotient
    on a positive tube yields the quotient's uniform bound on that tube.
items.title: exists_local_uniform_quotient_bound_of_continuousKernel

items.label: CenterResidualKernelCertificate.zeroFilledCubicQuotient_uniformBound
items.statement:
Helper for PhysicalDrift / Appendix Lemma A.6: a denominator-cleared center
    kernel certificate gives a local uniform bound for the parent zero-filled
    quotient `residual / (θ.1 * r ^ 3)`.
items.title: CenterResidualKernelCertificate.zeroFilledCubicQuotient_uniformBound

items.label: exists_local_uniform_quotient_bound_of_continuousKernel_on_punctured
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: a continuous kernel that agrees with a zero-filled
quotient away from its mixed cubic denominator yields a local uniform quotient bound.
items.title: exists_local_uniform_quotient_bound_of_continuousKernel_on_punctured

items.label: centerResidual_uniformBound_of_cubicFactorization
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: a cubic factorization of the concrete full-center
    residual and a bounded quotient imply its uniform mixed-variable cubic bound.
items.title: centerResidual_uniformBound_of_cubicFactorization

items.label: centerResidual_factorization_of_normalForm
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: an exact equality transporting the concrete center
    residual to a normal-form residual preserves the cubic-factorization certificate.
items.title: centerResidual_factorization_of_normalForm

items.label: CenterResidualKernelCertificate.residual_zero_of_weight_zero
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: vanishing of the mixed cubic weight forces the
    physical center residual to vanish under the two removable-branch certificates.
items.title: CenterResidualKernelCertificate.residual_zero_of_weight_zero

items.label: CenterResidualKernelCertificate.factorization
items.statement:
Helper for Appendix Lemma A.6: the zero-filled cubic quotient of a kernel-certified
    residual has the prescribed denominator-cleared factorization on every branch.
items.title: CenterResidualKernelCertificate.factorization

items.label: CenterResidualKernelCertificate.uniformBound
items.statement:
Appendix Lemma A.6 companion: a denominator-cleared continuous kernel certificate yields
    the uniform mixed-variable cubic bound for the physical center residual.
items.title: CenterResidualKernelCertificate.uniformBound

items.label: centerResidual_factorization_of_rawBracketKernel
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: a raw bracket kernel identity gives the
    punctured denominator-cleared residual factorization.
items.title: centerResidual_factorization_of_rawBracketKernel

items.label: centerResidual_eq_cubicWeight_smul_zeroFilledQuotient_on
items.statement:
Infrastructure I.16a: a scale-zero certificate restricted to a set gives the
    zero-filled cubic factorization on that set, including the universal radius-zero
    branch.
items.title: centerResidual_eq_cubicWeight_smul_zeroFilledQuotient_on

items.label: centerResidual_eq_cubicWeight_smul_zeroFilledQuotient_of_scaleZero
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: a global scale-zero certificate is the
    unrestricted specialization of the set-indexed zero-filled factorization.
items.title: centerResidual_eq_cubicWeight_smul_zeroFilledQuotient_of_scaleZero

items.label: centerResidual_eq_cubicKernel_of_bracketCertificateCover
items.statement:
Infrastructure I.16a: an existential raw bracket certificate on the punctured

items.title: tendsto_infDist_limitCircle_of_vectorRemainder

items.label: slowCurveBoundaryCenterTailIsBigO
items.statement:
For sufficiently small exact slow-curve orbits, cycle-boundary centers
approach any given limiting center with cubic order in the cycle scale.
items.title: slowCurveBoundaryCenterTailIsBigO

items.label: slowCurveMiddleCenterTailIsBigO
items.statement:
For sufficiently small exact slow-curve orbits, intermediate centers
approach the cycle-boundary limit with cubic order in the cycle scale.
items.title: slowCurveMiddleCenterTailIsBigO

items.label: norm_tsum_nat_add_le_of_majorant
items.statement: A summable nonnegative majorant bounds the norm of every shifted vector tail.
items.title: norm_tsum_nat_add_le_of_majorant

items.label: norm_tsum_nat_add_le_of_scaled_majorant
items.statement:
A scalar factor and a summable comparison sequence give a scaled vector-tail
bound.
items.title: norm_tsum_nat_add_le_of_scaled_majorant

items.label: norm_tsum_nat_add_le_of_power_bound
items.statement:
A pointwise power estimate gives the corresponding vector-tail bound, with
the exponent kept abstract for reuse by different decay regimes.
items.title: norm_tsum_nat_add_le_of_power_bound

items.label: norm_sub_limit_le_of_tsum_tail_eq
items.statement:
If a summable series tail is the displacement from a sequence value to its
limit, its norm is bounded by the tail of the increment norms.
items.title: norm_sub_limit_le_of_tsum_tail_eq

items.label: norm_sub_limit_le_of_summable_forward_difference
items.statement:
A convergent sequence with summable forward differences has its remaining
displacement bounded by the norm sum of those differences.
items.title: norm_sub_limit_le_of_summable_forward_difference

items.label: slowCurveEndpointClusterSet_eq_limitCircle
items.statement:
The endpoint cluster set of a sufficiently small invariant slow-curve orbit
is the affine unit circle determined by its limiting center and amplitude.
items.title: slowCurveEndpointClusterSet_eq_limitCircle

items.label: endpointCenter_defBasic
items.statement: The endpoint-center definition unfolds to endpoint minus endpoint gradient.
items.title: endpointCenter_defBasic

items.label: endpointCenter_evenBasic
items.statement: The endpoint center at an even index is the cycle-boundary center.
items.title: endpointCenter_evenBasic

items.label: endpointCenter_oddBasic
items.statement: The endpoint center at an odd index is the intermediate center.
items.title: endpointCenter_oddBasic

items.label: endpointCorrection_defBasic
items.statement: The endpoint-correction definition unfolds to gradient minus endpoint plus center.
items.title: endpointCorrection_defBasic

items.label: endpointCorrection_eq_centerBasic
items.statement: Endpoint correction is the chosen center minus the endpoint center.
items.title: endpointCorrection_eq_centerBasic

items.label: endpointCorrection_evenBasic
items.statement:
The endpoint correction at an even index is the chosen center minus the
cycle-boundary center.
items.title: endpointCorrection_evenBasic

items.label: endpointCorrection_oddBasic
items.statement:
The endpoint correction at an odd index is the chosen center minus the
intermediate center.
items.title: endpointCorrection_oddBasic

items.label: endpointRadius_defBasic
items.statement:
The endpoint-radius definition unfolds to the radius of the corresponding
cycle state.
items.title: endpointRadius_defBasic

items.label: endpointRadius_evenBasic
items.statement: The endpoint radius at an even index is the square of the cycle scale.
items.title: endpointRadius_evenBasic

items.label: endpointRadius_oddBasic
items.statement: The endpoint radius at an odd index is the square of the cycle scale.
items.title: endpointRadius_oddBasic

items.label: endpointScale_mul_radiusBasic
items.statement: The cube of a cycle scale equals that scale times its endpoint radius.
items.title: endpointScale_mul_radiusBasic

items.label: norm_endpointDisplacement_sub_gradient_eq_endpointCorrection
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure C: the endpoint correction has the norm of the
radial-minus-gradient perturbation used by the oriented-angle estimate.
items.title: norm_endpointDisplacement_sub_gradient_eq_endpointCorrection

items.label: abs_endpointCorrectionAngle_toReal_le
items.statement:
Infrastructure C: a positive common norm lower bound converts an endpoint
correction bound into a quantitative physical oriented-angle bound.
items.title: abs_endpointCorrectionAngle_toReal_le

items.label: abs_endpointCorrectionAngle_toReal_le_of_cubic
items.statement:
Infrastructure C: a fourth-order endpoint correction produces a cubic
physical oriented-angle error after division by the common radius.
items.title: abs_endpointCorrectionAngle_toReal_le_of_cubic

items.label: slowCurveEndpointSubCenterLimit_ne_zero
items.statement: Every endpoint of a sufficiently small slow-curve orbit avoids each limiting center.
items.title: slowCurveEndpointSubCenterLimit_ne_zero

items.label: endpointPolarAngleLift_eq_liftSequence
items.statement:
The recursively unwrapped endpoint-polar angle is the canonical lift of the
quotient-valued endpoint-polar angle sequence.
items.title: endpointPolarAngleLift_eq_liftSequence

items.label: endpointPolarAngleLift_even_eq_frameAngle_add_correction_of_mem_Ioc
items.statement:
A principal-interval branch-selection principle for the even endpoint-polar lift
relative to the accumulated frame angle.
items.title: endpointPolarAngleLift_even_eq_frameAngle_add_correction_of_mem_Ioc

items.label: endpointPolarAngleLift_even_eq_frameAngle_add_correction_of_small
items.statement:
If the correction, both intervening polar gaps, and the frame increment are each
smaller than `π / 8`, the even endpoint-polar lift selects the physical correction
branch relative to the accumulated frame angle.
items.title: endpointPolarAngleLift_even_eq_frameAngle_add_correction_of_small

items.label: slowCurveFrameAngleTendstoAtBot
items.statement:
Along every sufficiently small invariant slow-curve orbit, the unwrapped physical
frame angle tends to negative infinity.
items.title: slowCurveFrameAngleTendstoAtBot

items.label: slowCurveFrameRotation
items.statement:
Along sufficiently small invariant slow-curve orbits, the unwrapped physical
frame angle advances by `-3 * ε ^ 2` with a uniform fourth-order remainder.
items.title: slowCurveFrameRotation

items.label: slowCurveFrameAngleEventuallyStrictlyDecreases
items.statement:
For a sufficiently small invariant slow-curve orbit, adjacent unwrapped frame
angles are eventually strictly decreasing.
items.title: slowCurveFrameAngleEventuallyStrictlyDecreases

items.label: slowCurveFrameAngleDecreaseTendstoZero
items.statement:
For a sufficiently small invariant slow-curve orbit, the adjacent unwrapped
frame-angle decreases converge to zero.
items.title: slowCurveFrameAngleDecreaseTendstoZero

items.label: slowCurveOneTurnAmplitudeDropAsymptotic
items.statement:
Along a sufficiently small invariant slow-curve orbit, the amplitude drop
between cofinal iterates separated by one full frame turn is asymptotic to
`13 * Real.pi / 3` times the amplitude at the first iterate and the square of
its scale.
items.title: slowCurveOneTurnAmplitudeDropAsymptotic

items.label: slowCurveScalarAsymptotics
items.statement:
A sufficiently small invariant slow-curve orbit has the canonical scale,
amplitude, center, winding, and endpoint cluster-set asymptotics.
items.title: slowCurveScalarAsymptotics

items.label: IsWeakWolfe.transfer_of_endpoint_value_gradient_eq
items.statement:
Endpoint values and canonical gradients transfer a weak-Wolfe certificate to a second
objective whose endpoint differentiability is known.
items.title: IsWeakWolfe.transfer_of_endpoint_value_gradient_eq

items.label: IsWeakWolfe.transfer_of_endpoint_value_hasGradientAt
items.statement:
Certified endpoint gradients provide the canonical-gradient hypotheses needed to transfer a
weak-Wolfe certificate between objectives with matching endpoint data.
items.title: IsWeakWolfe.transfer_of_endpoint_value_hasGradientAt

items.label: IsWeak.transfer_of_endpoint_data
items.statement:
Endpoint values and line derivatives transport a weak Wolfe certificate to a second
objective, provided the second objective is line-differentiable at both endpoints.
items.title: IsWeak.transfer_of_endpoint_data

items.label: IsStrong.transfer_of_endpoint_data
items.statement:
Endpoint values and line derivatives transport a strong Wolfe certificate to a second
objective, provided the second objective is line-differentiable at both endpoints.
items.title: IsStrong.transfer_of_endpoint_data

items.label: IsWeak.orthogonalSum_iff
items.statement: Weak Wolfe satisfaction is invariant under embedding into an orthogonal-sum objective.
items.title: IsWeak.orthogonalSum_iff

items.label: IsStrong.orthogonalSum_iff
items.statement: Strong Wolfe satisfaction is invariant under embedding into an orthogonal-sum objective.
items.title: IsStrong.orthogonalSum_iff

items.label: alpha_mul_sq_le_of_weak_curvature
items.statement:
Weak-Wolfe curvature and a Lipschitz secant estimate imply the unnormalised step bound
`(1 - c₂) * (-⟪g,d⟫) ≤ L * α * ‖d‖ ^ 2`.
items.title: alpha_mul_sq_le_of_weak_curvature

items.label: alpha_lower_bound_of_weak_curvature
items.statement: A positive weak-Wolfe step with a Lipschitz secant estimate has an explicit lower bound.
items.title: alpha_lower_bound_of_weak_curvature

items.label: alpha_lower_bound_of_isWeakWolfe
items.statement:
A gradient-based weak-Wolfe certificate with a global Lipschitz gradient has the same
quantitative lower bound for a positive step `α • d`.
items.title: alpha_lower_bound_of_isWeakWolfe

items.label: alpha_lower_bound_of_isWeakWolfe_negGradient
items.statement:
For a steepest-descent direction, the general Wolfe step bound simplifies to
`(1 - c₂) / L`.
items.title: alpha_lower_bound_of_isWeakWolfe_negGradient

items.label: weakWolfe_decrease_lower_bound
items.statement:
A descent weak-Wolfe step decreases the objective by the usual one-step Zoutendijk
quantity when the gradient is globally Lipschitz.
items.title: weakWolfe_decrease_lower_bound

items.label: sum_range_le_of_term_le_sub
items.statement: A termwise bound by successive decreases telescopes over a finite initial segment.
items.title: sum_range_le_of_term_le_sub

items.label: zoutendijk_partial_sum_le
items.statement: Weak-Wolfe one-step decrease bounds the finite Zoutendijk sum along a sequence of steps.
items.title: zoutendijk_partial_sum_le

items.label: zoutendijk_partial_sum_le_of_contDiff_hessian_norm_le
items.statement:
A global `C²` Hessian norm bound supplies the Lipschitz-gradient hypothesis for the finite
Zoutendijk partial-sum estimate.
items.title: zoutendijk_partial_sum_le_of_contDiff_hessian_norm_le

items.label: zoutendijk_summable_of_bounded_below
items.statement: A lower-bounded objective makes the Zoutendijk directional-cosine series summable.
items.title: zoutendijk_summable_of_bounded_below

items.label: zoutendijk_summable_of_contDiff_hessian_norm_le
items.statement:
A global `C²` Hessian norm bound supplies the Lipschitz-gradient hypothesis needed by the
Zoutendijk summability theorem.
items.title: zoutendijk_summable_of_contDiff_hessian_norm_le

items.label: mapClusterPtExpOfVanishingStep
items.statement:
The exponential image of a strictly decreasing real sequence tending to negative infinity
with successive drops tending to zero has every point of the circle as an `atTop` cluster
point.
items.title: mapClusterPtExpOfVanishingStep

items.label: invFun_eq_self_of_bijective_of_eq_self_of_abs_ge
items.statement:
A bijection whose forward map is the identity outside an absolute-radius
interval has the same exterior identity for `Function.invFun`.
items.title: invFun_eq_self_of_bijective_of_eq_self_of_abs_ge

items.label: invFun_eq_self_of_strictMono_surjective_of_eq_self_of_abs_ge
items.statement:
Strict monotonicity plus surjectivity supplies the bijectivity needed by the
exterior inverse identity adapter.
items.title: invFun_eq_self_of_strictMono_surjective_of_eq_self_of_abs_ge

items.label: lipschitzWith_invFun_of_antilipschitz
items.statement:
An antilipschitz bijection has a reciprocal Lipschitz bound for its selected
right inverse `Function.invFun`.
items.title: lipschitzWith_invFun_of_antilipschitz

items.label: support_invFun_sub_id_subset_Icc
items.statement:
If a bijective forward map is the identity outside `[-R, R]`, the support of
its inverse displacement is contained in that interval.
items.title: support_invFun_sub_id_subset_Icc

items.label: norm_add_sub_le_of_split_estimates
items.statement:
A coordinate split bounds the output displacement by the standard rate times
the input discrepancy.
items.title: norm_add_sub_le_of_split_estimates

items.label: coe_splitRate
items.statement: Coercing `splitRate` to `ℝ` exposes the corresponding real coefficient.
items.title: coe_splitRate

items.label: splitRate_le_of_component_budgets
items.statement: Component budgets imply an upper bound for the split contraction coefficient.
items.title: splitRate_le_of_component_budgets

items.label: splitRate_lt_one_of_component_budgets
items.statement: A strict budget below one makes the split coefficient a strict contraction.
items.title: splitRate_lt_one_of_component_budgets

items.label: contractingWith_of_splitRate_bound
items.statement:
A pointwise sup-distance estimate with `splitRate` yields the corresponding
`ContractingWith` instance for a small-Lipschitz-graph transform.
items.title: contractingWith_of_splitRate_bound

items.label: uncurry_slice
items.statement:
Infrastructure I.16a: an eventual equality of uncurried maps restricts to
the second-coordinate slice through a fixed first coordinate.
items.title: uncurry_slice

items.label: uncurry_slice_left
items.statement:
Helper for Infrastructure I.16a: an eventual equality of uncurried maps
restricts to the first-coordinate slice through a fixed second coordinate.
items.title: uncurry_slice_left

items.label: exists_uniform_lower_bound
items.statement:
A jointly continuous scalar family that is strictly positive at a compact base slice
has one positive lower bound on a common parameter neighborhood.
items.title: exists_uniform_lower_bound

items.label: exists_uniform_lower_bound_finite
items.statement:
A finite collection of jointly continuous scalar families admits one lower bound and one
common parameter radius when every member is positive at the compact base slice.
items.title: exists_uniform_lower_bound_finite

items.label: exists_uniform_lower_bound_of_continuousAt
items.statement:
Pointwise continuity along a compact base slice and strict positivity on that slice
give one positive lower bound throughout a common scalar neighborhood.
items.title: exists_uniform_lower_bound_of_continuousAt

items.label: exists_uniform_lower_bound_finite_of_continuousAt
items.statement:
A finite family that is pointwise continuous along a compact base slice and
strictly positive there has one lower bound on one common scalar neighborhood.
items.title: exists_uniform_lower_bound_finite_of_continuousAt

items.label: exists_uniform_lower_bound_of_pointwise_continuousAt
items.statement:
Pointwise continuity at every compact base point and strict positivity on
that slice yield one positive lower bound on a common scalar neighborhood.
items.title: exists_uniform_lower_bound_of_pointwise_continuousAt

items.label: exists_uniform_lower_bound_finite_of_pointwise_continuousAt
items.statement:
A finite family of pointwise-continuous scalar functions on a compact base
shares one positive lower bound and one common scalar neighborhood.
items.title: exists_uniform_lower_bound_finite_of_pointwise_continuousAt

items.label: le_infDist_union_range_diff_singleton_of_indexed_bound
items.statement:
Pointwise, index-dependent lower bounds to a background set and an indexed family give the
same lower bound for every corresponding punctured union infimum.
items.title: le_infDist_union_range_diff_singleton_of_indexed_bound

items.label: infDist_pos_union_range_diff_singleton_of_indexed_bound
items.statement:
Positive indexed separation bounds produce positive punctured infimum distances from the
background set together with the indexed family.
items.title: infDist_pos_union_range_diff_singleton_of_indexed_bound

items.label: existsSubseqAddIntMulTendsto
items.statement:
Given a strictly decreasing real sequence tending to negative infinity whose successive
drops tend to zero, every target is approached along a subsequence after adding integer
multiples of any fixed positive period.
items.title: existsSubseqAddIntMulTendsto
